description:
Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Tecnologia Agrícola para atuar no nosso time de Corporativo de manutenção agroindustrial .

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Gerenciar a equipe de tecnologia agrícola das unidades, alinhando-se aos valores, Código de Ética e Conduta, políticas, diretrizes e procedimentos da empresa;
  • Desenvolver e implementar projetos de tecnologia nas unidades agroindustriais, promovendo segurança, aumento de produtividade e redução de custos;
  • Fornecer suporte na implantação de tecnologias de monitoramento de frota, telemetria, geotecnologias, softwares (sistemas especialistas);
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento das equipes de automação, incluindo treinamentos e diagnósticos de falhas;
  • Medir os impactos dos projetos nos KPIs da operação, áreas demandantes e da área de Tecnologia;
  • Colaborar com a área de TI na definição de arquitetura de solução, desenvolvimento e entrega de projetos;
  • Monitorar atividades de manutenção elétrica e automações, avaliando qualidade e eficiência, e orientar a equipe;
  • Gerenciar equipamentos embarcados, backups, inventário, custos e organização dos ambientes de trabalho.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Superior completo em Engenharias ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em telemática, elétrica-electrônica embarcada, mecânica, hidráulica, sistemas de computadores de bordo, pilotos automáticos, agricultura de precisão, GPS e rastreadores;
  • Conhecimento em pacote Office e Power BI.

Localidade

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia ou São José do Rio Preto.

O que buscamos em um profissional?

Buscamos talentos com atitude, engajamento e capacidade de estabelecer parcerias para enfrentar os desafios do setor, em um cenário de crescimento sustentável.

A Tereos valoriza a diversidade e aceita profissionais com deficiência.

A Tereos é uma líder no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas, com presença em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e cerca de 15.800 colaboradores, atuando nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Nosso compromisso social e ambiental reforça nossa atuação responsável e sustentável.

Tereos no Brasil

Operamos com unidades de processamento e refinarias em São Paulo, além de diversificar nosso portfólio com produtos derivados de milho e operações de trading internacional.

Join to apply for the (Salvador) Gerente Rafael Teixeira | Vendas – Seguro de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atuação Presencial) role at MAG Seguros .

Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Descrição:

Todos os dias, a ANDRITZ continua a fornecer soluções inovadoras de sucesso para nossos clientes globalmente. Por que temos tanto sucesso? Porque somos apaixonados e amamos o que fazemos! Estamos na vanguarda das tecnologias de engenharia do futuro, com soluções que garantem o sucesso de nossos clientes em setores-chave que estão moldando o futuro do mundo em que vivemos.

AANDRITZ possui como valores centrais, Paixão, Parceria, Perspectivas e Versatilidade, que definem a maneira como agimos e o que representamos.

Paixão: Você sente uma paixão genuína pelo seu trabalho? Procura constantemente superar-se?

Parceria: Você está em busca de uma oportunidade em que possa compartilhar valores e compromissos?

Perspectivas: Você está aberto a explorar e encontrar novos caminhos, tecnologias e ideias inovadoras para contribuir com o futuro promissor da ANDRITZ?

Versatilidade: Você está preparado para encarar novos desafios e abordá-los com flexibilidade e criatividade?

Se sim, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Como Gerente Tributário você terá como principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver estratégias legais para otimizar a carga tributária, aproveitando incentivos fiscais, regimes especiais ou estruturas mais vantajosas;
  • Avaliar os impactos tributários de decisões empresariais (ex: fusões, aquisições, novos produtos ou mercados);
  • Garantir a conformidade com a legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal;
  • Preparar e acompanhar fiscalizações e auditorias externas;
  • Realizar a gestão de riscos e contencioso tributário, monitorando mudanças na legislação que possam afetar a empresa;
  • Gerenciar litígios tributários, atuando junto a consultorias, advogados ou departamentos jurídicos;
  • Avaliar provisões contábeis relacionadas a riscos fiscais;
  • Manter interlocução com o Fisco e instituições públicas;
  • Avaliar pareceres jurídicos e técnicos de consultorias especializadas;
  • Representar a área em projetos estratégicos e iniciativas corporativas;
  • Coordenar o time fiscal, garantindo o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe e a aplicação das boas práticas ;
  • Garantir o correto cálculo, apuração e pagamento de tributos diretos e indiretos;
  • Supervisionar o envio das obrigações acessórias.

Esperamos que você tenha a seguinte formação:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós graduação e/ou MBA relacionados a área Tributária serão diferenciais.

Procuramos candidatos com as seguintes habilidades técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFIN, IRPJ e CSLL;
  • Conhecimento em Tributação Internacional (COMEX, Transferpricing);
  • Conhecimento em Direito Tributário;
  • Pacote Office – intermediário/avançado;
  • Sistema SAP;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI – diferencial;
  • Inglês – intermediário/avançado;
  • Espanhol – diferencial.

Buscamos pessoas com forte desejo de aprender e progredir junto com a ANDRITZ Hydro!

JUNTOS SOMOS ANDRITZ.

Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para o emprego independentemente da raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de género, origem nacional ou deficiência.

Você será a primeira pessoa de Produto da Bipa e terá um papel estratégico e altamente influente na definição do futuro da empresa. Isso inclui estabelecer as bases de produto, estruturar o fluxo entre áreas, conectar negócio com execução e garantir que as decisões estejam sempre ancoradas em dados e no que realmente gera valor.

Buscamos alguém com experiência sólida, que pense como dono e que se sinta confortável em ambientes com múltiplas variáveis regulatórias, técnicas e operacionais. Sua missão será garantir que estamos resolvendo os problemas certos, da melhor forma possível, com eficiência e cadência.

Responsabilidades

  • Entender profundamente nossos usuários, produtos e o ecossistema cripto/financeiro, incluindo regulação, liquidez e modelos de negócio.
  • Estabelecer o fluxo de descoberta, priorização e entrega com visão de eficiência e escala.
  • Levantar, organizar e priorizar demandas estratégicas em conjunto com engenharia, design, operações, compliance e negócio.
  • Explorar dados de forma autônoma e orientar decisões com base em evidências (quantitativas e qualitativas).
  • Definir metas, acompanhar KPIs e garantir entregas que movem as métricas-chave da empresa.
  • Apresentar resultados, aprendizados e próximos passos com clareza, alinhando constantemente com a liderança.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento, eficiência e novos produtos em ciclos rápidos de teste/aprendizado.
  • Promover e fortalecer a cultura de produto na empresa (experimentação, impacto, agilidade, foco no usuário).
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre as áreas, com comunicação fluida e foco no contexto compartilhado.

Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência como Product Manager em fintechs, exchanges, bancos digitais ou ambientes altamente regulados.
  • Forte senso de ownership: capacidade de tocar iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta, mesmo com baixa definição inicial.
  • Capacidade de navegar entre estratégia e execução com profundidade — de sessões com liderança a decisões de arquitetura com engenharia.
  • Familiaridade com blockchain, Lightning Network e custodia.
  • Conhecimento em Pix, Banking e cartão de crédito (FIDC, crédito rotativo, risco).
  • Visão data-driven com habilidade para construir análises, dashboards e análises próprias a partir de ferramentas como Metabase, Amplitude, Firebase, FullStory, etc.
  • Intimidade com SQL e autonomia para gerar seus próprios insights a partir de dados estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Clareza de comunicação — tanto escrita quanto verbal — para engajar liderança, pares e áreas operacionais.
  • Background técnico e experiência prévia com projetos complexos de engenharia.
  • Fluência técnica para discutir arquitetura, escopo e trade-offs com engenheiros.
  • Mentalidade centrada no usuário sem perder o foco nos objetivos do negócio.
  • Inglês avançado.

Desejáveis (não obrigatórios)

  • Conhecimento de BACEN, SPB, regulamentação e legislação financeira.
  • Experiência em produtos B2C com alto volume de usuários.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alto crescimento.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de go-to-market.
  • Formação ou especialização em gestão de produtos digitais.

O que oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de ser a primeira pessoa de Produto e crescer junto com a empresa.
  • Contato direto com a liderança e participação nas decisões estratégicas.
  • Cultura de autonomia, transparência e foco em resultados.
  • Remuneração competitiva.
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco sem coparticipação.
  • Vale-refeição/alimentação CAJU.
  • Auxílio home office.
  • Auxílio moradia (após 3 meses de empresa).
  • Programa Bipa Monstra - estímulo à saúde física.

A Bipa é a fintech líder da América Latina que promove a independência financeira das pessoas através do Bitcoin, simplificando seu uso no dia a dia e desenvolvendo novas soluções. Oferecemos compra, venda e saques de Bitcoin, além de integrá-lo com serviços financeiros tradicionais.

Se você é apaixonado por Bitcoin e valoriza inovação, colaboração e compromisso com a excelência, a Bipa é o lugar para você. Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos os funcionários são incentivados a trazer suas ideias e experiências únicas. Estamos empenhados em promover o crescimento pessoal e profissional de nossa equipe.

title: Director, Engineering
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Walt Disney Company and Epic Games are collaborating on an all-new games and entertainment universe.

In addition to being a world-class games experience, this new persistent universe will offer a multitude of opportunities for consumers to play, watch, and engage with content, characters, and stories from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, Avatar, and more.

Players, gamers, and fans of all kinds will be able to create their own stories and experiences, express their fandom in a distinctly Disney way, and share content with each other in ways that they love. Come join us in creating the future of interactive entertainment.

Epic Games is seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to join this team. This person should be a gaming industry veteran with strong hands-on experience to join our engineering team. As a part of the team, you will be representing and leading one of our main games engineering groups, helping it to grow, improve, plan, and prioritize work. At the same time, you will become a part of the leadership group, where you will set and plan product vision, actively participate in decision-making, and message the big picture across multiple groups. Our ideal candidate is a passionate individual with experience working on AAA games with live services. Someone who is excited about pushing the limits of what’s possible through applying state-of-the-art technology and best engineering practices to build gameplay that will transform how games are made.

In this role, you will
  • Lead a team of engineers, to whom you will be communicating vision, setting priorities, and mentoring
  • Regularly both manage and mentor engineering leads and individual contributors
  • Work hands-on with engineering groups across different departments, brainstorming, architectural solutions, helping in decision making, and similar
  • Work closely with the leadership group, building and shaping product vision
  • Play an active role in proposing, setting up, executing, and delivering on new initiatives
  • Be a point of contact for cooperation with other Epic teams and initiatives
  • Provide inputs into the product road map, including milestone schedules and deliverables
What we're looking for
  • 10+ years of experience in the game industry
  • Experience shipping a AAA product with live services in a leadership-based position
  • Experience leading large teams distributed across multiple countries and time zones
  • A technical leader who excels at giving feedback and has demonstrated capabilities facilitating team success
  • Deep expertise in the product lifecycle for games, such as generating detailed technical requirements, assembling capable teams, executing said requirements, and building robust support systems to manage them
  • Strong engineering background, with an advanced understanding of software architecture, design principles, data structures, and algorithms
  • Great communication skills, verbal and written, with experience working in a fast-paced environment with cross-disciplinary teams
  • Experience working with Unreal Engine
  • Advanced knowledge of C++
  • Agile and product-oriented mindset
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

Título: Gerente de Marketing (Eventos)

Local: São Paulo

Missão do cargo

Gerenciar iniciativas de patrocínio, ativações e experiências de marcas, desenvolver relacionamento e parcerias com o mercado de entretenimento, esportes, games, e liderança de time composto por coordenadores e analistas. Responsável pelo planejamento estratégico de experiência de marcas e patrocínios, gestão de eventos proprietários e patrocinados nacionais, relacionamento com o mercado, desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de patrocínio e parcerias. Liderança de agências e stakeholders para a realização das iniciativas.

Principais atribuições

  • Desenvolver estratégia de experiências de marcas e patrocínios para as marcas da Companhia, considerando iniciativas proprietárias, eventos de terceiros patrocinados, gestão de budget e controle de KPIs;
  • Monitoramento do mercado de entretenimento e esportes, mapeamento e prospecção de oportunidades, de acordo e alinhado aos territórios de atuação das marcas;
  • Negociação de patrocínios e parcerias, análise de propostas e oportunidades, estudo de viabilidade de investimento e alinhamento com a estratégia da marca, seguindo o processo de compras/jurídico;
  • Relacionamento e gestão de agências do pool. Briefings, feedbacks estruturados, direcionamentos, análise de planilhas de orçamento, gestão de cronogramas, acompanhamento dos projetos e gerenciamento de ações in loco;
  • Relacionamento e atuação próxima de stakeholders internos, como Jurídico, Compras, Segurança, Midia, Marcas, Trade, Regionais;
  • Acompanhar e gerenciar mensalmente o budget, gerenciar os KPIs das marcas e área, visando o atingimento das metas e melhoria de performance;
  • Atuar e cuidar dos processos da área, respeitando as políticas da Companhia (jurídica, financeira, segurança, códigos de conduta, direitos humanos, sustentabilidade);
  • Gestão de contratos e contrapartidas de patrocínio negociados;
  • Realizar atividades administrativas da área, através da elaboração de relatórios de projetos, controles e análises de KPIs, ROIs, junto ao time e líder de Business Intelligence;
  • Facilitar o fluxo dos processos internos para a realização das iniciativas, através do planejamento das atividades da área e da divulgação prévia dos mesmos para as áreas correlacionadas;
  • Gestão de time: liderança e desenvolvimento de profissionais (analistas e coordenadores);
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com o mercado de entretenimento, esportes, games, identificar e prospectar novas oportunidades de patrocínio e parcerias para a Companhia e Marcas;
  • Perfil: ser uma pessoa muito bem informada sobre tendências, cultura, esporte. É importante vivenciar o mercado, ter o lifestyle coerente com a atuação profissional;
  • Ser bem conectado com o mercado e ter habilidade social.

Formação acadêmica

Ensino superior completo em áreas correlatas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas;
  • Conhecimento em eventos e patrocínios.

  • Transmitir a cultura da organização, seus objetivos e metas, sua missão e visão à equipe liderada.

  • Capacidade de compreender o impacto de qualidade nos resultados da empresa e antecipar riscos regulatórios e operacionais;

description:
Join to apply for the SR UX designer role at dLocal

Join to apply for the SR UX designer role at dLocal

Why should you join dLocal?
dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.
By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.
What’s the opportunity?
We are looking for an experienced hands-on Senior UX Designer to join the Product team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the execution and the strategy of our main products, you’ll have a special focus on the transactional products and top merchant’s conversion rates, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to articulate business needs and user needs into thorough user experiences.
What will I be doing?

  • Lead the UX design process throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring that the solutions support the company’s overall strategy and goals
  • Communicate with different stakeholders to gather and prioritize product and customer requirements
  • Collaborate with global teams across engineering and product management to deliver scalable, user-friendly solutions
  • Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to illustrate design concepts and interactions
  • Create user journey maps, and other UX artifacts to inform the design process
  • Conduct and evaluate quantitative and qualitative user research, to gather insights and validate design decisions
  • Work closely with developers to ensure feasibility and assist in the implementation of UI elements
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles throughout the product development lifecycle
  • Evaluate and measure the business impact of design and product solutions

What skills do I need?
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field (or equivalent and demonstrable work experience)
  • +5 years of experience working in digital products as a UX Designer or similar role, with a strong portfolio showcasing diverse projects
  • Solid understanding of user-centered design principles and product lifecycle
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to translate data into actionable and scalable insights
  • Experience with user research methodologies and usability testing techniques
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision
  • Familiarity with product management tasks

Nice to have:
  • Experience leading teams and defining product strategies.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
  • Knowledge and understanding of the payments industry and emerging markets context
  • Proficiency in utilizing metric tools, analyzing performance, and optimizing conversion funnels

What do we offer?
Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:
  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?
Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!
Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal!

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients.   • Experience driving a managing ITSM processes in a matrixed management environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply governance, regulatory / legal, and financial constraints to enterprise service management.
  • Balance the interest of the enterprise and operational design in continuous improvement activities.
  • Prior experience working in a hybrid support model with portion outsourced and portion insourced.

At WTW, we believe difference makes us stronger. Description
The Supply Chain Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing Amazon Brazil's transportation network, while integrating broader supply chain planning aspects.
In this role you will

  • Develop and maintain advanced network optimization models to enhance transportation efficiency, reduce costs, and improve delivery speed across the supply chain.
  • Evaluate and refine existing optimization models, ensuring they accurately reflect current operational constraints, business objectives, and end-to-end supply chain impact.
  • Design and implement scalable processes for middle-mile (MM) lane planning, integrating with broader supply chain metrics such as cost, speed, and inventory placement.
  • Ensure alignment between operational planning (OP) cycles, guidance, and overall network strategy, including FC capacity, speed plans, and inventory positioning.
  • Engage with key stakeholders across finance, transportation, and network strategy teams to communicate short, mid, and long-term supply chain plans effectively.
  • Support central teams in developing comprehensive supply chain planning chapters for strategic documents and planning cycles.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the finance structure to validate numbers upfront and minimize rework.
  • Create and document overall processes, identify key stakeholders, map data flows, and determine required inputs and expected outputs across the supply chain network.
  • Lead initiatives to scale planning operations, reduce manual workload, and integrate benchmark tools and automation with the SC optimization team.
  • Continuously analyze supply chain data to identify trends, opportunities for improvement, and potential risks in the network.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in supply chain planning, a strong background in data analysis and modeling, and the ability to translate complex analytical insights into actionable strategies. They should possess excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams and levels of the organization.

Planning & Modeling
  • Lead network optimization modeling to enhance transportation efficiency and cost;

  • Design scalable processes for middle-mile (MM) lane planning.
Cross-functional Leadership
  • Partner with finance, transportation, and network strategy teams;
  • Support central team with strategic planning documentation;
  • Lead stakeholder engagement across organization;
  • Validate financial impact of network decisions.

  • Supply chain experience

O Gerente de Área de Negócios é responsável por disseminar informações atualizadas e relevantes sobre os produtos da Biogen, promovendo a educação continuada dos profissionais de saúde (médicos, farmacêuticos, entre outros) para que eles possam prover o melhor tratamento aos pacientes que vivem com Esclerose Múltipla.

At Baxter, we are deeply connected by our mission. No matter your role at Baxter, your work makes a positive impact on people around the world. You'll feel a sense of purpose throughout the organization, as we know our work improves outcomes for millions of patients.

In this role, you will serve as the focal point for Human Resources Operations, managing local, regional, and global HR processes, payroll, labor law, budget, and people analytics for assigned teams.   • Prepare data to support Baxter in negotiations and contracts with unions.
  • Prepare and maintain HR Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in payroll management, supplier management, and internal controls.
Experience in negotiating and contracting with relevant unions.
Familiarity with eSocial and other government obligations, including DCTFweb, Social Security, and Income Tax.
Proficiency in Workday and ADP systems.
Advanced skills in the Microsoft Office Suite, with a strong emphasis on Excel.

About The Company
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

About The Company
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.
We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).
To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.
Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.
About The Team/role
The Financial Institution Business Development (FIBD) team focused on payments plays a critical role in shaping and managing strategic partnerships with banks, payment providers, and other financial stakeholders. Our mission is to enhance the company’s payment capabilities, ensuring a seamless, secure, and efficient transaction experience for our customers across multiple business units, including ride-hailing and 99Pay.
As part of the online payments vertical, we work closely with acquirers, issuers, card schemes, and alternative payment providers to optimize payment operations, expand local payment acceptance, reduce costs, and drive innovation. Collaboration with internal stakeholders—such as risk, compliance, legal, treasury, and product teams—is key to ensuring regulatory compliance and continuous improvement of our payment ecosystem.
By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the rapidly evolving payments landscape, working on high-impact projects that drive financial efficiency and enhance the user experience.
In this role, you'll be...

  • Own and lead initiatives to improve payment success rates, optimize transaction flows, and enhance operational resilience across various payment methods (e.g., cards, PIX, and alternative payments).
  • Act as the subject matter expert on payment performance, working cross-functionally with product, risk, legal, compliance, and treasury teams to identify and implement improvements.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, analyze trends, and use data to inform decisions and advocate for changes that enhance user experience and business outcomes.
  • Manage relationships with external payment service providers, acquiring banks, and card schemes—ensuring alignment on strategic priorities, issue resolution, and future roadmap collaboration.
  • Stay ahead of regulatory changes, payment industry trends, and technology developments, ensuring our systems and strategies remain compliant and competitive.
  • Drive the integration of new payment solutions and enhancements, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, and testing requirements for smooth implementation.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...
  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in payments, fintech, financial operations, or a related area, with demonstrated experience leading projects or initiatives.
  • Desirable: Previous experience in the card benefits market in Brazil — particularly with meal and grocery vouchers—including familiarity with key players, regulatory frameworks, commercial and operational models.
  • A data-driven mindset and strong analytical skills, with the ability to draw insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable strategies.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—comfortable engaging with internal teams and external partners across regions (English proficiency required).
  • A self-starter attitude with the ability to work independently, make informed decisions, and drive projects forward in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility to work across time zones, especially Brazil and China, as part of a global team.

You'll love working at DiDi because...
We create user value
We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.
We are data-driven
We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
Win-win Collaboration
Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
We believe in integrity
Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
Growth
We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion
Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.
We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.
We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

description:

One application submitted for a specific position does not automatically include you to be considered for all positions that you may be qualified to perform.

Job Purpose

Perform maintenance and repair of all inside and outside cable plant at USAP stations. The position is responsible for the maintenance and troubleshooting of the telephony systems for the station, fiber/copper cable plant for 1200+ users. The position provides critical required tasking such as fiber optic splicing, copper cable splicing and providing end user assistance with network and telephone troubleshooting and usage on the station.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Ensure that work areas meet all ASC and USAP safety standards.
  • Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace program and ensuring safety is the highest priority in the work place.
  • Provide phone system management.
  • Input cable and equipment data into Cable Management Software.
  • Assist communications Department with Black Island related events.
  • Survey all OSP cables and hardware for damage and schedule repairs as necessary.
  • Provide voice/data services to outlying field sites.
  • Provide support for testing and implementation of (802.11b) wireless LAN devices.
  • Install and repair Analog telephones.
  • Install and maintain inside and outside CATV, UTP, and Fiber distribution plant.
  • Install and maintain LAN cable drops & runs.
  • Maintain Automated Teller Machines and associated network equipment.
  • Update cable plant optical fiber and UTP as-builts.
  • Maintain Telco inventory and records.
  • Support Pair Gain DSL Systems.
  • Install and maintain all network transmission and distribution media, including twisted pair and optical fiber.
  • Maintain up to date cable records.
  • Update SOPs as needed.
  • Provide installation and maintenance support for HDSL transmission facilities.
  • Assist in annual departmental inventory and re-supply ordering.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship or permanent residency is required.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required. Continued education in technical courses pertaining to telecommunications electronics is preferred.
  • Minimum four years of experience in telecommunications systems is required.
  • Must be able to install, troubleshoot, and maintain OSP/ISP Fiber, OSP/ISP Copper, up to industry standards.
  • Experience with wiring standards and protocols required.
  • Solid understanding of logical and systematic troubleshooting techniques is required.
  • Excellent command of computers and software used in modern telecommunications facilities is required. Familiarity with the use of telecommunications test equipment, OTDRs, bit error rate testers and communications analyzers are required.
  • BICSI Installer Certification preferred.
  • Experience with Cable Management Software systems preferred.
  • Familiarity with electronics equipment cabling and standard installation wiring practices is required. Minimum two years' experience maintaining digital communications equipment preferred.

Competencies

  • Technical Capacity.
  • Organizational Skills.
  • Strategic Thinking.
  • Problem Solving/Analysis.

Physical Requirements

  • Deployment will be required in this position. The individual in the position must successfully complete physical and dental examinations as required by the NSF for deploying to Antarctica. Failure to meet these requirements may result in withdrawal of employment offer or other employment action.
  • Complies with applicable USAP/ASC safety, environmental, health, and waste management policies and procedures.
  • Individual must be capable of operating a standard desktop computer; must be able to lift and carry up to 10 pounds.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Position Expectations

  • This is a full-time, seasonal position located in Antarctica.
  • All expenses paid while deployed including meals, lodging, cold-weather gear, tools, and travel to/from Antarctica.
  • Candidate must be able to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.
  • Performance Period: October 2025-February 2026.

Job description

Buscamos um profissional para coordenar o desenvolvimento das etapas de exploração de um conjunto de projetos de exploração mineral da empresa, considerando planos de mapeamento geológico, geoquímica, geofísica, sondagem e estimativa de recursos e reservas, dar o suporte às equipes de Planejamento de Lavra de Longo Prazo no desenvolvimento de modelos geológicos e de lavra, desenvolvendo e aplicando metodologias e processos para geologia de longo prazo em interface direta com a equipe, avaliar eventualmente ativos externos e participar em visitas de terceiros para possíveis vendas ou negociações.


Main responsibilities

  • Assegurar a retenção, desenvolvimento, desempenho, treinamento, capacitação, solução de conflitos, comunicação e reconhecimento da equipe, conforme as diretrizes da área de Pessoas e Cultura.
  • Planejar e coordenar as atividades de projetos de exploração mineral da empresa.
  • Compilar, integrar e analisar os dados gerados pelas equipes de exploração para definir a sequência das atividades, em alinhamento com a Coordenação Geral.
  • Programar, acompanhar e executar sondagens prospectivas e de detalhe, com foco na cubagem de reservas minerais.
  • Reportar resultados estratégicos para a Coordenação Geral, Gerência e Diretoria da área de Exploração.
  • Participar da elaboração de relatórios técnicos exigidos por órgãos como a ANM (Agência Nacional de Mineração), além de relatórios internos mensais.
  • Revisar documentos e entregas das equipes de exploração, garantindo a qualidade técnica dos dados e produtos gerados.
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, a geologia de curto prazo das operações, atuando em interface direta com as equipes de geologia de mina e planejamento.

Requirements and skills

Formação em Geologia/ Engenharia geológica

Experiência consolidada com experiência superior a 10 anos aplicados à exploração e pesquisa mineral.

Domínio das melhores técnicas de pesquisa para diferentes tipos de commodities, principalmente minério de ferro.

Conhecimento em técnicas modernas de amostragem geoquímica, métodos geofísicos e sondagens.

Experiência em gestão de projetos, com foco em cronogramas, prazos e controle de custos.

Habilidade no processamento de dados geoquímicos, petrológicos e estatísticos aplicados à prospecção mineral.

Vivência em pesquisa geológica em ambientes greenfield , brownfield e em operações de mina.

Interpretação de dados geológicos em ambientes tridimensionais (3D).

Experiência com estimativa de recursos minerais por meio de softwares especializados (ex.: Leapfrog, Micromine, Datamine).

Conhecimento na elaboração de relatórios técnicos exigidos por órgãos reguladores, como a ANM.

Liderança e habilidade para desenvolver e engajar equipes multidisciplinares.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de troca contínua de informações com diferentes áreas.

Capacidade de atuar em ambientes desafiadores, com autonomia e responsabilidade.

Flexibilidade para adaptação a mudanças e novas metodologias.

Espírito colaborativo e habilidade para mediar conflitos e manter o clima organizacional positivo.

Grupo EP Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade , atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.
Com mais de 50 anos de existência, estamos entre as 5 maiores empresas em tratamento de água e análises ambientais no país.
Já ajudamos nossos clientes a tratarem mais de 700 milhões de m³ de efluentes — o equivalente ao consumo anual de água de 12 milhões de pessoas (toda a população do Estado de SP).
Contamos com mais de 500 colaboradores , atuando em 5 frentes especializadas : Analítica, Engenharia, Equipamentos, Química e Tech.
Nosso objetivo é claro: expandir nossa atuação em todo o Brasil até 2033 .
Nossos valores
Paixão por aprender
Valorizamos e investimos no crescimento do nosso time. Acreditamos que conhecimento é nosso maior ativo — por isso, oferecemos acesso a cursos, formações e subsídios educacionais.
Falo e faço
Aqui, a coerência entre discurso e prática é essencial. Transparência, ética e responsabilidade norteiam nosso relacionamento com clientes, parceiros e colegas.
Visto a camisa
Estamos em busca de pessoas comprometidas, que se conectem com nosso propósito e tenham orgulho de fazer parte dessa transformação ambiental.
Hoje melhor que ontem
Acreditamos no poder da melhoria contínua. Pequenas evoluções diárias nos tornam uma empresa melhor e mais relevante para o mundo.
Se você também é #MOVIDOAAGUA e deseja fazer a diferença com o seu trabalho, vem com a gente!
Missão do cargo: As operações terceirizadas tem como responsabilidade garantir o perfeito funcionamento das estações de tratamento do nosso cliente, a fim de não poluir o meio ambiente, atendendo as legislações ambientais e oferecendo água de qualidade para uso em processos internos, quando necessário.
Como Será Seu Dia a Dia
Atuar na área operacional de estações de tratamentos de água e efluentes (industriais e domésticos) e reuso de água, mantendo em perfeito funcionamento;
Realizar monitoramento dos volumes dos tanques;
Realizar leitura de temperatura, pH, turbidez, Resíduos Sedimentáveis e Sedimentabilidade do lodo, de acordo com os procedimentos internos;
Preparar e repor produtos químicos inerentes ao processo de tratamento;
Preencher planilhas de controle – trabalho diário e controle de qualidade;
Verificar indicadores de funcionamento;
Operar e realizar pequenas manutenções em equipamentos pertinentes à área;
Controlar e organizar o estoque de reagentes, vidrarias e equipamentos do laboratório, reportando necessidades de reposição;
Realizar coleta de amostras para análise em laboratório;
Realizar análises químicas de baixa complexidade;
Prezar pela organização e manutenção do ambiente de trabalho;
Manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.

Curso Técnico em Química, Meio Ambiente ou áreas correlatas;
CRQ ativo;
Experiência mínima de 1 ano com tratamento de água/ efluentes.

title: Account Manager
description:
Description

As part of Willis Towers Watson’s Captive Solutions team, the Account Manager plays a key role in delivering tailored management services to a portfolio of captive insurance companies. Captive Solutions spans multiple business segments—including Corporate Risk and Broking (CRB), Human Capital and Benefits (HCB), and Investment, Risk and Reinsurance (IRR)—and offers clients innovative, data-driven approaches to risk financing.

This role supports the strategic and operational performance of client captives through active engagement in underwriting, regulatory compliance, financial management, and governance. The Account Manager collaborates closely with internal experts—including actuaries, risk consultants, accountants, and brokers—as well as with external stakeholders such as clients, regulators, and service providers.

With no two captives alike, the Account Manager must bring flexibility, analytical insight, and client-focused problem-solving to help structure and manage bespoke captive solutions. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a team that combines industry-leading analytics, strategic consultancy, and operational excellence to deliver clarity and value to our clients.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

Ensures strong relationships with client, regulators, captive directors and key service providers.

Works as part of the Client Service Team, as well as interacts with clients, prospects, regulators and external service providers.

Insurance

  • Liaison with insurance broker and reinsurance brokers as required.
  • Assist with underwriting decisions in conjunction with the Client Service Team and the Practice Underwriting resources, as appropriate.
  • Monitoring of exposures and risk transfer pricing within assigned portfolio.
  • Assist with regulatory approval for changes to the business plan.
  • Assist with Board approval for underwriting decisions.

Finance/Regulatory

  • Monitoring of domicile solvency and capital requirements
  • Obtaining regulatory approval of changes to business plan
  • Obtaining board approval for underwriting decisions Accounting for premium Agree reserving methodology
  • Ensure the production of management accounts, statutory accounts and information, budgets, cash flow statements and supplementary information as required.
  • Assist with the adoption of appropriate accounting practices and ensure adherence thereto.
  • Manage cash requirements of the companies Liaise with and monitor investment managers in respect of invested funds
  • Assist Client Service Team with co-ordination of board meetings
  • Ensure timely production of board papers.
  • Ensure timely production of minutes and review prior to distribution.
  • Action matters arising from client meetings
  • Ensure relevant company secretarial functions are performed in a timely manner.
  • Ensure compliance with Corporate Governance.

Management

  • To participate in and provide input on strategic and major operational issues.
  • Assume responsibility for a specific area of company strategy.
  • To implement policies adopted by the Practice Contact is maintained with all client directors and that they are advised of any developments.
  • Keep Practice leadership apprised of client developments.
  • Entertain clients & prospects as required.
  • Support Senior Executive in performing board insight, perspective & thought leadership as required
  • Understands importance of Internal Control procedures and the WTW code of Conduct and works to be seen as a role model in the office.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • 2-4 year degree in Accounting, Finance or related area
  • Computer Skills
  • A plus, but not required is knowledge and experience of captive insurance and insurance industry in the following areas: (1) accounting for captives (2) insurance products, and (3) problem resolution
  • Willis Towers Watson knowledge (platforms, structure, etc.)
  • Ability to monitor quality control Client relationship skills
  • Project Management skills

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.
Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation.

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $70,000-$100,000 USDper year.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)

Description and Requirements

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Global Process & Enablement Manager to lead and evolve global initiatives across Custom Fulfillment Services (CFS). In this strategic role, you will be responsible for optimizing core processes, driving knowledge sharing, enabling sales efficiency, and improving reporting and operational visibility.

This role requires someone who excels at connecting the dots across people, process, and technology — and is passionate about creating scalable, standardized, and automated solutions that enhance both internal efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, document, and standardize end-to-end CFS processes across all regions to ensure operational consistency and scalability.
  • Complete initial global process documentation with structured quarterly reviews and updates.
  • Identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with stakeholders to implement automation or AI-driven solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with 100% of regional site teams across geographies.
  • Compile and manage a global CFS Best Practice Playbook, sharing practical process insights and regional expertise.
  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and evangelist for CFS, presenting CFS process improvements or strategic learnings with internal and external stakeholders
  • Design and implement automated tools (e.g., Power Apps) for tracking global part number usage, with real-time dashboards accessible by geo.
  • Collaborate with MSCT and Operations teams to produce actionable, leadership-level CFS dashboards and monthly reporting packages.
  • Ensure visibility of trends, KPIs, and escalations across senior stakeholders to support data-informed decisions.
  • Identify and resolve friction points in the sales cycle related to CFS quoting or delivery, driving measurable improvements in quoting speed or win rates.
  • Partner with regional Sales Enablement teams in North America and Latin America to deliver localized training and guidance aligned with market needs.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making across the CFS organization.
  • Actively use the Business Management System (BMS) in partnership with regional leaders to surface and address systemic issues such as delays, fulfillment errors, or process breakdowns.
  • Ensure CFS operations consistently support a high-quality customer experience through reliability, responsiveness, and proactive issue resolution.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in project management, global operations, process improvement, or business program management.
  • Strong background in process documentation, workflow design, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Demonstrated experience with automation tools, reporting platforms (e.g., Power BI, Power Apps), and dashboarding.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills.
  • Comfortable working across global time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.

Preferred

  • Experience with Service Delivery, fulfillment services, or adjacent supply chain/customer operations functions.
  • PMP, Lean Six Sigma certification or process excellence credentials.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese required, written and verbal. Spanish preferred.

About The Team/Role
We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive Information Security GRC Analyst Level 3 – PCI DSS Compliance to support our organization’s PCI DSS compliance efforts. This role will focus on ensuring strict adherence to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) while contributing to broader governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in PCI DSS and the ability to drive compliance programs in complex environments.

About The Team/Role
We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive Information Security GRC Analyst Level 3 – PCI DSS Compliance to support our organization’s PCI DSS compliance efforts. This role will focus on ensuring strict adherence to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) while contributing to broader governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in PCI DSS and the ability to drive compliance programs in complex environments.
How You'll Make An Impact
Participate and play a key role in the WEX PCI DSS compliance program, ensuring ongoing adherence to the latest PCI DSS requirements.

  • Conduct and coordinate PCI DSS gap assessments, control evaluations, and risk assessments to identify and remediate deficiencies.
  • Conduct and coordinate PCI DSS annual reviews in accordance with PCI DSS v4.0.1.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for external audits, working closely with Qualified Security Assessors (QSAs), auditors, and regulatory bodies to ensure successful compliance certifications.
  • Develop and maintain PCI DSS policies, procedures, and documentation to align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with IT, Security, Legal, and Business teams to integrate PCI DSS controls into enterprise security and risk management frameworks.
  • Implement security and compliance automation tools to enhance PCI DSS control effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Stay updated on PCI DSS regulatory changes and evolving threats, advising on necessary adjustments.
  • Support broader GRC initiatives, including ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, and risk management programs, as needed.
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for PCI DSS, advising stakeholders on compliance strategies, risks, and security best practices.
Experience You'll Bring
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Experience in information security, compliance, risk management, or a related field, with a strong focus on PCI DSS compliance. Experience with PCI issuing banks preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: In-depth understanding of PCI DSS, security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2), risk management methodologies, cloud environments (AWS and Azure), and secure network architectures.
  • Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills; ability to communicate effectively with both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Tools & Technologies: Experience with GRC tools, security compliance platforms, vulnerability management tools, and cloud security.
  • Certifications (Preferred): PCI Professional (PCIP), Qualified Security Assessor (QSA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).

description:

Join to apply for the Project Manager role at Hogarth

Hogarth is the Global Content Experience Company. Part of WPP, Hogarth partners with one in every two of the world’s top 100 brands including Coca-Cola, Ford, Rolex, Nestlé, Mondelez and Dyson. With a breadth of experience across an extensive range of sectors, Hogarth offers the unrivaled ability to deliver relevant, engaging, and measurable content across all channels and media - both established and emerging. The number of channels at our fingertips; the need for speed; and the drive for mass personalisation, all mean that brands need different solutions. Our global team of over 7,500 craft and technology experts brings together creative, production and innovation to help clients navigate this exciting and ever-changing world of today’s content experience.
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. Working at WPP means being part of a global network of more than 100,000 talented people dedicated to doing extraordinary work for our clients. We operate in over 100 countries, with corporate headquarters in New York, London and Singapore. WPP is a world leader in marketing services, with deep AI, data and technology capabilities, global presence and unrivalled creative talent. Our clients include many of the biggest companies and advertisers in the world, including approximately 300 of the Fortune Global 500. Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.
A Hybrid working model
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
The Role
Project Managers own the end-to-end project management of projects. They are responsible for delivering a completed project on time, on specification, and on budget. Project Managers must demonstrate a good understanding of project management tools and best-practice methodology, and the flexibility to lead a diverse and dynamic team to deliver balanced integrated solutions. The project manager is everyone's point person for the project. Team members rely on them for everything they need to know about a project: what to expect, what to do next, and to find out where they need to be. Project Managers relay information about timing, scope, budgets, resources and changes to the project plan.
The successful candidate will use their superior problem-solving skill and have a desire to learn. They will have a passion for print production, as well as marketing and advertising.
Key Areas Of Responsibilities
Communication

  • The key day-to-day project contact with lower to mid-level clients
  • Possesses accurate sense of client satisfaction level - facilitates the sharing of client feedback with the team and management; sensitive to the client's needs and concerns.
  • Takes accountability to ensure that all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables
Collaboration
  • Partners with the client services, project management, production and finance leads across channels to ensure a smooth process, proper resource allocation, and a superior end result
  • Ensures team members feel personal accountability for deliverables and projects, engaging in all aspects of team assignments driving towards progress, actions and results
  • Develops and maintains high levels of team effectiveness (trust, communication, collaboration, productivity diversity and engagement)
Process
  • Manage small to medium sized projects independently, from initiation through completion
  • Serve as the production expert on integrated marketing campaigns, working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Possesses an in-depth understanding of project management techniques and brings process innovation in how we manage our engagements
  • Manages client objectives, budgets, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicating changes/directions to team members
  • Keeps projects on track through clear task lists, issue tracking, status reports, and meeting notes
  • Participates actively and can knowledgably articulate status internally or during client interactions
  • Influences the efficiency and quality of work and advocating for the agency/client relationship
Financial Management
  • Works with interdisciplinary teams of creative, production and technologists to define and develop scopes and estimates of projects (goals, deliverables, schedule, and budget), helping to translate creative concepts into clear sets of deliverables with proper staffing
  • Owns project budget and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolution of budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients
Risk Management
  • Focuses on delivering great print work and proactively identifies barriers to creating great work and works to remove them, when applicable, raises larger issues to senior management
Day to day tasks can include
  • Develops and maintaining scopes, timelines and budgets
  • Coordinates and partners with Hogarth’s global production network to ensure global campaign launches are successful and work is completed
  • Manages status documents, agendas, contact reports, trackers and day to day communication with teams and client
  • Liaises with clients/agencies/suppliers to obtain schedules, briefs, assets, technical specifications
  • Responsible for partnering with the Business Affairs team to manage and plan talent, licensing and vendor costs
  • Manages of POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets
Requirements
  • 2-5 years of project management with print production experience in integrated agency or similar environment
  • Solid understanding of print production and the creative development process, knowledge digital retouch, delivery of artworks for PRINT and POS / OOH.
  • A professional and approachable demeanor, and the ability to thrive in the dynamic highly matrixed agency environment
  • Ability to manage big volume of print assets´s delivery demonstrating skills to deliver on time and on budget
  • Can show experience in bottom-up scoping of projects, creating project budgets, tracking actuals, and creating statements of work
  • Demonstrates an ability to solve problems with the solution that works for all stakeholders without compromising the quality of the deliverables or the project
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, wireframing/workflow tools, online project management/collaboration/ticketing tools e.g. JIRA, Service Anywhere, Sharepoint, Smartsheet etc.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

A Little Bit About Us
We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.
We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.
We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.
Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.
You can read more about our company here and about our team and culture here. Also, head to our blog for more news about what we’re building and how we work.
About The Team

  • We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack.
  • Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do.
  • We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback.
  • We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.
  • While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up between 3 pm and 6 pm, CEST.
  • Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.
Your Opportunity
  • Shape our AI strategy: Identify, prioritize, and execute on high-impact AI initiatives that accelerate company-wide efficiency and innovation.
  • Engage deeply with the tech: Rapidly build, test, and deploy internal tools and customer-facing features using the latest AI technologies.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with product, engineering, operations, and business teams to discover use cases and implement intelligent systems that solve real problems.
  • Bring ideas to life: Lead full-lifecycle development—ideation, prototyping, evaluation, iteration, deployment, and maintenance of AI services.
  • Embrace rapid learning and iteration: Embrace fast-paced cycles, quick experiments
This Position May Be For You If
  • You’ve contributed to building and maintaining LLM-powered systems in production settings.
  • You’re comfortable working with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, or PydanticAI and applying them in context.
  • You're familiar with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its design considerations.
  • You integrate AI tools like agents or copilots into your workflow to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • You’re curious about new models and tools, and thoughtful about what’s practical for production use.
  • You bring solid engineering skills in Python (and ideally Django or FastAPI), and care about writing maintainable, well-tested code.
  • You value sharing progress early, collaborating closely with stakeholders, and view learning as an iterative process.
  • You bring 5+ years of experience in software engineering or building technical products.
  • You're fluent in English, written and spoken, and can clearly articulate technical decisions to diverse audiences.
Amazing If
  • Have previous experience in Fintech or SaaS product environments.
  • Have experience building agentic systems that integrate across tools and APIs.
  • Have worked in fast-paced or small-team environments where ownership and adaptability are important.
  • Have experience designing thoughtful evaluation approaches for AI features.
  • Have experience working with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures or vector databases.
Our Tech Stack
  • We’re building our platform using modern technologies, putting the focus on reliability and long-term maintainability
  • We primarily use Python on the backend. We use battle-tested technologies such as Django, and we are heavy users of Python’s asyncio for some parts of our stack
  • We use Javascript, Vue.js and Sass on the frontend. We are developing and leveraging our own design system and component library
  • We run our infrastructure on top of Amazon Web Services, leveraging managed services. We tend to favor the use of managed services wherever possible, in order to focus on our business problems
  • We observe and monitor our services using Datadog
  • We follow Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery best practices

title: Product Manager - Plataforma de Crédito
description:
Há 10 anos, desafiamos o mercado financeiro com soluções acessíveis e inovadoras. Aprovamos até 2x mais que outros players, com tecnologia que combina mais de 400 fatores para oferecer crédito rápido e sem complicação, usando só CPF e celular.
No Jeitto, dar um jeito é pra hoje. Temos urgência porque nosso cliente tem urgência. É por isso que buscamos, todo dia, dar um jeito pra que quem faz muito com pouco continue fazendo mais e melhor sempre.
A área de Core Crédito é o coração tecnológico do nosso negócio. Ela é responsável por construir e evoluir a infraestrutura central, os motores e os serviços que permitem à Jeitto criar, lançar e operar todos os produtos de crédito de forma rápida, escalável e segura. Somos o alicerce que habilita a inovação e o crescimento de todas as outras squads de produto.
A posição de Product Manager da Plataforma de Crédito é responsável por definir a visão e o roadmap da espinha dorsal do nosso sistema de crédito. No dia a dia, você irá traduzir a estratégia de negócio em capacidades de plataforma, colaborar intensamente com arquitetos e engenheiros para desenhar soluções robustas e interagir com os PMs de produto final para garantir que eles tenham as ferramentas certas para inovar. Seu impacto é direto na agilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência de toda a operação de crédito do Jeitto.
Este não é um desafio sobre gerenciar um produto, mas sobre construir o motor que impulsiona todos os nossos produtos de crédito. Você terá a oportunidade única de resolver problemas complexos na base do nosso negócio, impactando não apenas um, mas múltiplos produtos simultaneamente.
Os principais atrativos são:

  • Impacto Amplificado: Cada entrega sua não melhora apenas uma funcionalidade, mas destrava valor e acelera o desenvolvimento de toda a área de crédito. Seu trabalho será a base para o futuro do Jeitto.
  • Complexidade Técnica e Estratégica: Você estará no centro das discussões mais estratégicas, conectando a visão de negócio com arquitetura de software de ponta. Se você gosta de pensar em sistemas, escalabilidade e resolver quebra-cabeças complexos, esta é a sua arena.
  • Visão de Legado: Você não estará apenas "apagando incêndios". Seu foco será construir uma plataforma sólida e de longo prazo, deixando um legado de tecnologia e eficiência para a empresa. É a chance de construir o "core" do zero da maneira certa.
Nesta posição você irá:
  • Liderar o discovery técnico e de negócio para definir os componentes, microsserviços e APIs da plataforma de crédito.
  • Criar e gerenciar o roadmap de evolução da plataforma, priorizando capacidades que aceleram o time-to-market dos produtos.
  • Escrever épicos e histórias técnicas com foco em contratos de API, requisitos não-funcionais (escalabilidade, latência, segurança) e a "experiência do desenvolvedor".
  • Garantir a integração robusta com todo o ecossistema de crédito (bureaus, reguladores, parceiros) e atuar como facilitador para as squads de produto que consomem a plataforma.
Para essa posição, é necessário que você tenha:
  • Experiência como Product Manager em produtos de plataforma, técnicos, de infraestrutura ou core bancário/financeiro.
  • Compreensão sólida do ciclo de vida do crédito (originação, análise, formalização, etc.) sob a ótica de sistemas e processos.
  • Profundo entendimento de arquiteturas de microsserviços, APIs e plataformas como produto.
  • Liderança técnica e habilidade para dialogar em profundidade com engenheiros e arquitetos sobre o design de sistemas.
  • Vivência com squads multidisciplinares em ambiente ágil, com forte capacidade de comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência prévia na construção ou gestão de CaaS (Credit as a Service)
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados e como ela suporta uma plataforma de serviços.
  • Background técnico em engenharia de software ou arquitetura de sistemas.
O Jeitto acredita e celebra o poder da diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades como ferramenta de desenvolvimento, crescimento e transformação. Reafirmamos nosso compromisso com a inclusão e estamos empenhados com a criação de um ambiente de igualdade de oportunidades para todos os recortes sociais.

A Andrade Gutierrez se destaca como uma das maiores empresas de engenharia da América Latina e nossa trajetória tem sido marcada pela busca por novas oportunidades e grandes desafios.

  • Analisar necessidades de compras de peças e componentes para equipamentos, principalmente linha amarela e rodoviária;

  • Monitorar desempenho dos fornecedores (prazo, qualidade, atendimento);

  • Atuar com visão analítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de compras;

  • Realizar interface com a área de manutenção para alinhamento de necessidades técnicas das peças;
  • Realizar lançamentos, análises e extrações no sistema SAP;
  • Atuar com autonomia na condução de demandas complexas;

É com a força da #NossaGente que construímos o futuro e chegamos cada vez mais longe!

A empresa atuou e atua em alguns dos projetos mais importantes do país e do mundo. Estamos presentes nos setores de infraestrutura, mobilidade urbana, mineração, energia, óleo e gás.

Sempre à frente do seu setor, e alinhada às melhores práticas, a Andrade Gutierrez criou, em 2018, o Vetor AG: primeiro programa de inovação aberta do setor de Engenharia e Construção, responsável por fazer o mapeamento e conexão dos desafios da AG com soluções inovadoras do mercado. Supergasbras is part of the Dutch group SHV Energy, a global leader in Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) distribution with over 100 years of experience. Our mission is to deliver clean and efficient energy to millions of Brazilians across residential, commercial, industrial, and agribusiness sectors. We develop projects focused on digital transformation, customer experience, innovation, and sustainable business development. Our strategy emphasizes trust and integrity to become Brazil's best energy company for our customers, partners, employees, and shareholders, with a commitment to social and environmental responsibility.

At Supergasbras, diversity and inclusion are business priorities. We value and believe in the development of people both professionally and personally, promoting gender equity, including people with disabilities, respecting all sexual orientations, and fighting racial discrimination at all levels of society.

Being diverse is being Super!

Responsibilities and Duties

Job Objective

Responsible for the production of LPG bottling in P13 / P20 / P45 packages, logistics for serving resellers and bulk customers across DF and surroundings, industrial maintenance of the bottling unit, QSMS of the unit, LEAN and people management of a team of 100 employees.

  • Use of Lean tools (problem solving, performance management, GEMBA, 5S).
  • Monitor operational KPIs of the unit.
  • Manage technical and legal documents (ISO 9001).
  • Control attendance of direct employees.

  • Promote team engagement and development.
  • Implement and maintain safety and environmental procedures, fostering a safety culture.
  • Participate in internal and external audits related to operational activities.
  • Train production team for safe and effective operation.
  • Ensure proper recording and control of production data, batch traceability, and compliance with ANP and other regulatory standards.
  • Support quality department in handling non-conformities related to the production process.
  • Conduct operational and alignment meetings with logistics, maintenance, quality, and safety teams.

Requirements and Qualifications

Mandatory Requirements

  • Complete higher education in Mechanical, Electronic, Civil, Electrical, Aerospace, or Production Engineering.
  • Intermediate English proficiency.
  • Intermediate/advanced proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

Desirable Requirements

  • Knowledge of Power BI.

Additional Information

At Supergasbras, we recognize and support our employees with excellent benefits and programs.

  • Health & Well-being: Medical, Dental, and Gympass.

  • Financial Planning: Profit sharing and private pension.

  • Development: Corporate University and Learning programs.
  • Celebrations: Birthday leave.
  • Other Benefits: Exclusive perks.
