What makes us Super?

We value people and everything they bring: ideas, contribution, partnership, and collaboration. We strive to create a work environment that fosters human and professional development, encouraging interaction, active participation, and growth. We believe success comes from collective energy and collaboration.

What exactly do we do?

As part of the SHV Energy Group, a global LPG distributor and one of Brazil's leading gas companies with over 75 years of experience, we operate the most modern bottling plant in Latin America and have over 20 industrial units nationwide. description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

The Financial Institution Business Development (FIBD) team focused on payments plays a critical role in shaping and managing strategic partnerships with banks, payment providers, and other financial stakeholders. Our mission is to enhance the company’s payment capabilities, ensuring a seamless, secure, and efficient transaction experience for our customers across multiple business units, including ride-hailing and 99Pay.

As part of the online payments vertical, we work closely with acquirers, issuers, card schemes, and alternative payment providers to optimize payment operations, expand local payment acceptance, reduce costs, and drive innovation. Collaboration with internal stakeholders—such as risk, compliance, legal, treasury, and product teams—is key to ensuring regulatory compliance and continuous improvement of our payment ecosystem.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the rapidly evolving payments landscape, working on high-impact projects that drive financial efficiency and enhance the user experience.

Role Responsibilities

  • Own and lead initiatives to improve payment success rates, optimize transaction flows, and enhance operational resilience across various payment methods (e.g., cards, PIX, and alternative payments).
  • Act as the subject matter expert on payment performance, working cross-functionally with product, risk, legal, compliance, and treasury teams to identify and implement improvements.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, analyze trends, and use data to inform decisions and advocate for changes that enhance user experience and business outcomes.
  • Manage relationships with external payment service providers, acquiring banks, and card schemes—ensuring alignment on strategic priorities, issue resolution, and future roadmap collaboration.
  • Stay ahead of regulatory changes, payment industry trends, and technology developments, ensuring our systems and strategies remain compliant and competitive.
  • Drive the integration of new payment solutions and enhancements, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, and testing requirements for smooth implementation.

  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in payments, fintech, financial operations, or a related area, with demonstrated experience leading projects or initiatives.
  • Desirable: Previous experience in the card benefits market in Brazil — particularly with meal and grocery vouchers—including familiarity with key players, regulatory frameworks, commercial and operational models.
  • A data-driven mindset and strong analytical skills, with the ability to draw insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable strategies.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—comfortable engaging with internal teams and external partners across regions (English proficiency required).
  • A self-starter attitude with the ability to work independently, make informed decisions, and drive projects forward in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility to work across time zones, especially Brazil and China, as part of a global team.

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.

  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

Atuar na prospecção e qualificação de clientes interessados em investimentos, sendo a porta de entrada para futuras oportunidades dentro da área comercial da Sacre BTG Pactual. O SDR terá a missão de identificar potenciais investidores, gerar conexões estratégicas e agendar reuniões qualificadas para os Assessores de Investimentos, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da carteira e para o atingimento das metas da equipe. Faça parte da Sacre e transforme o mercado financeiro! Job description

Sobre a Rodobens:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

Automóveis

Somos um dos maiores grupos de concessionárias do Brasil, representamos as marcas: Toyota, Mercedes-Benz e Hyundai.

Somos ao todo 19 concessionárias distribuídas pelo país, sendo uma Hyundai, duas Mercedes-Benz e dezesseis Toyota, atuando na comercialização de veículos novos e seminovos, assistência técnica, peças, pneus, acessórios e serviços adicionais, além de soluções integradas nas áreas de consórcio, seguros, financiamento e serviço de leasing & locação de veículos.

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio Completo;

title: Account Executive - Captive Management
description:
Description

Willis Towers Watson’s Captive Solutions team delivers customized, data-driven insurance management services across Corporate Risk and Broking (CRB), Human Capital and Benefits (HCB), and Investment, Risk and Reinsurance (IRR). As part of this highly specialized group, the Account Executive is responsible for managing a portfolio of captive insurance companies by providing strategic, operational, and financial oversight tailored to each client’s unique risk profile.

Reporting to senior leadership and working closely with clients, regulators, and service providers, the Account Executive plays a critical role in shaping underwriting strategy, ensuring regulatory and financial compliance, and delivering timely, high-quality board and management reporting. The role also contributes to new business development by identifying growth opportunities, supporting marketing initiatives, and offering expert technical guidance.

The ideal candidate brings at least 15 years of experience in captive insurance and financial services, with deep knowledge of insurance accounting, products, and problem resolution. Strong leadership, project management, and client relationship skills are essential, along with the ability to provide strategic insight, influence stakeholders, and uphold the highest standards of compliance and corporate governance.

This position offers a dynamic opportunity to lead within a team of top-tier professionals—actuaries, brokers, analysts, and consultants—dedicated to delivering clarity, innovation, and value to clients through Willis Towers Watson’s world-class Captive Solutions platform.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

New Business

  • To assist in the development of new business for the Company
  • Give input to the creation of a marketing and new business strategy.
  • Implement marketing and new business strategy.
  • Identify new business opportunities (including cross-selling opportunities) within existing client base.
  • Take responsibility for a number of new business development projects.
  • Promote the Company within and outside the Willis Group.
  • To provide technical advice on request within the Practice.

Insurance

  • Liaison with insurance broker and reinsurance brokers as required.
  • Underwriting decisions in conjunction with the Client Service Team and the Practice Underwriting resources, as appropriate.
  • Monitoring of exposures and risk transfer pricing within assigned portfolio.
  • Oversee regulatory approval for changes to the business plan.
  • Oversee Board approval for underwriting decisions.

Finance/Regulatory

  • Monitoring of domicile solvency and capital requirements
  • Obtaining regulatory approval of changes to business plan
  • Obtaining board approval for underwriting decisions
  • Accounting for premium
  • Agree reserving methodology
  • Ensure the production of management accounts, statutory accounts and information, budgets, cash flow statements and supplementary information as required.
  • Assist with the adoption of appropriate accounting practices and ensure adherence thereto.
  • Manage cash requirements of the companies
  • Liaise with and monitor investment managers in respect of invested funds
  • Assist Client Service Team with co-ordination of board meetings
  • Ensure timely production of board papers.
  • Ensure timely production of minutes and review prior to distribution.
  • Action matters arising from client meetings
  • Ensure relevant company secretarial functions are performed in a timely manner.
  • Ensure compliance with Corporate Governance.

Management

  • To participate in and provide input on strategic and major operational issues. Assume responsibility for a specific area of company strategy.
  • To implement policies adopted by the Practice
  • Contact is maintained with all client directors and that they are advised of any developments.
  • Keep Practice leadership apprised of client developments.
  • Entertain clients & prospects as required.
  • Support Senior Principal in performing board insight, perspective & thought leadership as required
  • Understands importance of WEM and the WTW code of Conduct and works to be seen as a role model in the office.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • 4 year degree in Accounting, Finance or related area or CPA qualification
  • Maintenance of CPA qualification through CPD, as appropriate
  • Advanced Computer Skills
  • In depth knowledge and experience of captive insurance and insurance industry (minimum 15 years’ experience) in the following areas: (1) accounting for captives (2) insurance products, and (3) problem resolution
  • Willis Towers Watson knowledge (platforms, structure, etc.)
  • Ability to monitor quality control
  • Client relationship skills
  • Project Management skills
  • Advanced presentation skills
  • Leadership and People Management skills
  • Compliance
  • Can solve complex issues and will raise highly complex issues to higher level
  • Ability to influence and negotiate
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.
Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation.

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $100,000-$140,000 USDper year.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (Washington State only )
  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k).

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

We understand flexibility is key to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce and so we encourage requests for all types of flexible working as well as location-based arrangements. Please speak to your recruiter to discuss more.

title: Regulatory Specialist - Mandates
description:
EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: toprovide global access for everyone. We believe that transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey is crucial! That's precisely why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day in 29 rising markets across the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

As a Regulatory Specialist, your mission will be to strategically oversee and manage all aspects of regulatory compliance within the organization, ensuring adherence to relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards. You will support the development and implementation of robust regulatory strategies, provide expert guidance on complex regulatory matters, and proactively identify and mitigate regulatory risks.

You will also be responsible for:

  • Continuous monitoring of updates to mandates issued by credit card brands.
  • Translation of complex mandates into what is relevant to the business model and the creation of clear and efficient action plans.
  • Communication with the teams responsible for the proper implementation of the requirements within the deadlines, as well as monitoring the action plans for this implementation.
  • Alignment of mandate requirements with business strategies, generating operational and commercial gains.

Main requirements for this position:

  • Experience in technical negotiations with card brands.
  • Ability to represent the company in forums, committees and meetings with brands and regulators.
  • In-depth knowledge of the brands' expectations and possible flexibilities, which can provide competitive advantages.

What would be a plus?

  • Experience with Payment Institution or Exchange will be considered a differential.

EBANX offers:

  • Spanish, English, and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • EBANX Education: financial support for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs so you can develop important skills for your career;
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: Birthday Day Off;
  • Semi-flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX;
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics stores, and more!

Follow us on LinkedIn and check out our Instagram to learn more about the #ebanxlife.

Nascemos com um propósito: ser o pilar e a segurança dos nossos clientes. Nossa missão é ser uma alcateia e, como bons lobos, utilizar estratégia e união para nos tornarmos dominantes no setor de pagamentos.

About Us

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work with us.

The opportunity: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

As a Business Analyst, you will help ZCAM’s customers by understanding their needs and developing solutions to business problems. You will work with multidisciplinary and international teams to gather requirements, document processes, and communicate findings. Your responsibilities will include collecting and documenting business needs, analyzing data to identify trends and insights, suggesting process improvements, creating reports and presentations for stakeholders, and collaborating with teams to implement solutions. Additionally, you will be key to ensure that project objectives align with business goals, and will lead meetings and workshops to drive project success. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential for this role.

  • Plans, conducts and facilitates incubation sessions for business requirements gathering with subject matter experts and end users ensuring deliverables are met
  • Adapts and applies different delivery methodologies determining the best methodology for the specific project
  • Contributes to business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Produces requirement specifications and outlines solution design documents throughout the project life cycle, incorporating change requests and finalization of requirements documentation
  • Analyzes and manages requirement risk, traceability matrix and prioritizes requirements
  • Performs quality review checks on project deliverables
  • Participates in development of test plan, testing, implementation and training activities
  • Participates in post implementation activities including problem solving and measurement of benefits achieved
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels
  • Creates compelling project documents such as business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Manages interdependencies within the projects and other functions
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or science or a related field, any higher degree is an advantage
  • Professional experience in related role and/or demonstrated competency (projects) utilizing relevant technologies
  • Balanced mix of business acumen as well as affinity to technology and systems
  • Innovative and creative self-starter, highly motivated, business and IT savvy
  • Independent and able to handle multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Must possess in-depth, strong problem-solving analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Experience in the delivery of business solutions in time, quality, and budget
  • Proven experience as business analyst or subject matter expert in global projects and/or sound knowledge in insurance business

  • Tough-minded, highly flexible and determine to deliver assigned targets
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Experience in application testing and organizing user acceptance testing
  • Customer-oriented team player with good communication abilities, fostering effective collaboration and teamwork
  • Strong proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required, Spanish language skills are a plus.

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich wants to attract the best talent and we acknowledge that talents might not always be available full-time. At Zurich we will consider requests for flexible working. Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of ways. Please talk to us during the interview about the flexibility you may need.

Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.


Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.


Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;

Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Segmento Posterior ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.

  • Proficient in working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).

  • Knowledge of web networking protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, WebSockets) and security best practices (authentication, authorization, encryption).
  • Experience with performance profiling, optimization techniques, and software algorithms.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
It Helps If You have
  • Experience with back-end testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Mocha).
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms and deployment processes (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
  • Familiarity with message queuing systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka).

Part investigative researcher, part creative writer, and 100% YouTube consumer, the Content Writer will be responsible for the ideation, research, and execution of highly engaging Reaction compilations. They will also write light hearted and funny outlines for talent to follow in each episode.

The ideal candidate is a YouTube junkie who understands how to make relevant content for the current generation of viewer, loves comedy, and wants to help guide the creative ship for one of the leading Content Production companies in the creator game!

  • YouTube obsessed and likes to have fun and be weird
  • A solutions oriented problem solver who isn't afraid of radical candor

description:
The Business Unit Leader leads their team towards success in creating sustainable people, profit, and planet value, by adopting the following roles:

1. Member of the Operations team

The Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. They are actively involved in:

  1. Sharing best practices between Business Units and contributing to Plant performance in a collaborative manner, maintaining a "ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM" mindset.
  2. Detecting and developing talents to grow their careers in the Shop, exporting talent to support business needs.
  3. Supporting Shop decisions even under uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances.
  4. Improving Business Unit performance through coaching and feedback.
  5. Providing input on support team members' performance and development recommendations.

2. People developer

The Business Unit Leader is passionate about developing people, viewing their plant as a platform for recruitment, training, and professional growth. They are expected to:

  1. Promote a lifelong learning mindset by evaluating competencies and identifying development opportunities.
  2. Ensure development through Spoke training and social promotion projects.
  3. Utilize accessible career paths for all employees.
  4. Build and believe in diverse teams.
  5. Support competency development via mentoring and coaching.

3. Representative/Role model of Company values, purpose & strategy

The Business Unit Leader embodies the group's values and represents the Plant to employees by:

  1. Living out values and inspiring through behavior.
  2. Motivating teams using Michelin purpose & Dream.
  3. Ensuring understanding of the Plant strategy and individual roles in collective success.
  4. Aligning the shop vision and engaging teams to realize it.
  5. Addressing employee issues timely and ensuring accurate attendance records.
  6. Developing Safety as a core value, ensuring responsibility for safety among employees.

4. Customer & business partner

The Business Unit Leader understands customer needs and guides teams to be customer-centric. They are expected to:

  1. Understand customer requirements and their role in meeting expectations.
  2. Focus on all aspects of economic value creation.
  3. Support business through collaboration on industrialization, digitalization, and industry transformations.

5. Environment promoter

The Business Unit Leader promotes sustainability and environmental impact reduction by:

  1. Fostering a culture valuing sustainability and environment.
  2. Implementing strategies for environmental impact and biodiversity.

CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE

6. ICARE & Empowerment role model

Leading with the ICARE leadership model, inspiring and coaching teams to progress by:

  1. Inspiring passion for ICARE at all levels.
  2. Creating inclusive, safe, collaborative, and intelligent team environments.
  3. Fostering empowerment and engagement in plant evolution and transformation.

7. Operational Excellence Leader

Developing operational excellence by ensuring:

  1. Activities apply MMW practices, creating sustainable foundations for performance.
  2. Continuous progress through variation and non-value tasks reduction.
  3. Achievement of SMQDC performance levels and standards compliance.
  4. Team empowerment, increased autonomy, and responsibility.
  5. Effective problem-solving to eliminate root causes.

TECH AREA of EXCELLENCE

8. Digital and Innovation contributor

Driving innovation, engineering, and technology transformation by:

  1. Encouraging digital application use and data-driven approaches.
  2. Building foundations for transformation (data quality, skills, organization, roadmap).
  3. Supporting projects that develop capabilities aligned with Michelin strategy, promoting digital best practices.

Techfins são empresas de tecnologia que querem utilizar sua força de desenvolvimento para distribuir e democratizar o acesso aos melhores produtos financeiros.
Nossa missão é ampliar, baratear e simplificar a contratação de serviços financeiros das empresas brasileiras para que elas possam comprar, pagar, vender e receber de forma ágil e sem complicações.

description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional orientado(a) a resultados e com atenção a detalhes para atuar comoEspecialista de ITAM , com forte foco em Gestão de Ativos de Hardware (HAM) , dentro de nossa equipe de Serviços Gerenciados . A função será responsável pelo suporte operacional diário, execução de processos e garantia de qualidade dos dados em ambientes de clientes, utilizando as plataformas ServiceNow ITSM/ITAM ou Flexera One .
Esta posição desempenha um papel fundamental na governança, conformidade e desempenho dos ativos de hardware ao longo de seu ciclo de vida — desde a aquisição até a baixa — apoiando áreas como compras, estoque, distribuição, manutenção e descarte.
Responsabilidades Principais
• Executar e monitorar os processos degestão de ciclo de vida de ativos de hardware , conforme as melhores práticas ITIL e ISO/IEC 19770.
• Manter e reconciliar osinventários de ativos de hardware , garantindo precisão e integridade nos registros (ServiceNow, Flexera, ERP, UEM, etc.).
• Operar as plataformasServiceNow ITAM/HAM ou Flexera One , realizando a gestão de registros de ativos, almoxarifados e transições de status.
• Processar movimentações, alocações, devoluções, descartes e atividades de renovação de ativos, com base em workflows e automações estabelecidas.
• Apoiar atividades denormalização, deduplicação e limpeza de dados , assegurando qualidade das informações e alinhamento com o CMDB.
• Executar auditorias periódicas, conciliações e relatórios para garantir conformidade com contratos e políticas internas.
• Interagir com áreas de compras, logística, suporte de campo e operações de TI para garantir o atendimento dos pedidos e manutenções.
• AcompanharSLA de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço envolvidos com o suporte a hardware.
• Apoiar o onboarding de novos clientes ou unidades, incluindo carga inicial de dados, definição de perfis de ativos e parametrização de processos.
• Elaborar e manterprocedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) , contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços.


Requisitos Desejados
• Graduação em TI, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).
• Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência prática com ITAM/HAM , preferencialmente em ambiente de serviços gerenciados ou multi-clientes.
• Sólido conhecimento prático das plataformasServiceNow ITSM/ITAM/HAM ou Flexera One .
• Familiaridade com frameworks de governança comoISO/IEC 19770 , ITIL ou CSDM .
• Domínio de Excel, ferramentas de relatórios e integrações com CMDB/ERP.
• Capacidade de analisarnotas fiscais, garantias, cronogramas de depreciação e contratos de ativos .
• Desejável experiência com ferramentas de UEM/Discovery (ex.: SCCM, Intune, JAMF, Tanium, Lansweeper).
• Perfil analítico, boa comunicação, capacidade de resolução de problemas.
• Inglês fluente (espanhol são diferenciais positivos).
Certificações Desejáveis
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – HAM / ITAM
• Fundamentos do ServiceNow ITSM ou ITOM
• Certificação Flexera – Flexera One ITAM
• ITIL v4 Foundation
• ISO/IEC 19770-1 Awareness ou Practitioner
Modelo de Trabalho e Ferramentas
• Gestão de chamados: ServiceNow, Jira ou plataforma do cliente
• Colaboração: Microsoft Teams, Outlook, SharePoint
• Relatórios: Performance Analytics (ServiceNow), Excel, Power BI

Overview


The Security Analyst I serves as Tier 1-2 Analyst member of the Bunge Global SOC and all operational activities that serve to protect the confidentiality, integrity and security management of business and employee information and systems in compliance with organization policies and standards. He/she will focus on structured tasks associated with proactive response, initial identification and remediation of suspicious network and host based activity. The successful candidate will have significant and demonstrated skills in the areas of: TCP/IP protocols; malware and virus behavior. The candidate should display strong technical depth that spans PC and server software, application and custom code. A solid technical background in computer vulnerabilities, attack vectors and exploits is required.

Essential Functions


Perform as part of the CTDO group, initial analysis, triage and response tasks of cyber events with the security team to operate a global SOC for Bunge to safeguard the company's assets, intellectual property and information systems.
Conduct Tier 1 SOC activities to collect, store, and correlate, analyze, identify and respond to security data derived from sensors.
Implement, configure, and optimize the detection and reporting capabilities of company’s global security tool suite.
Collect and analyze intrusion artifacts (e.g., event logs, source code, malware) and use discovered data to support incident response actions.
Conduct rapid incident response activities and cyber event investigations.
Conduct a level of critical thinking as it relates to root cause analysis of actual or suspected security incidents recommended corrective actions.
Provide and or contribute to the development of ad-hoc information security reports to be shared with the Information Security Working Group and other executive leadership, as required

Qualifications


Preferred candidate has 1-4+ years’ experience in the Information Technology field
Minimum of 2+ years of direct experience in Cyber Security, SOC operations, Incident Response, and Security tool integration & operations is required.
1+ years direct experience with Splunk, Fidelis, Falcon Host, Firewall and IDS/IPS technologies preferred.
1-2+ year in any position: system administrator, application developer, database administrator, LAN administrator.
Associate or Bachelor’s degree of Science in computer science, information systems, engineering, or programming
Industry recognized certifications such as, GSEC, GCIA, CEH. CISCO a plus
Intermediate scripting knowledge in Perl, PHP, ASP or Java with recent and basic programming experience as a plus
Minimum of 2 years of experience in compliance-oriented industry is preferred.
Advanced understanding and demonstrated technical skils and abilities in the technical information security operations domain
Ability to conduct analysis of multiple data sources and provide assessment on the relationship between threats, vulnerability and information value in the context of risk management for company.
Bi-lingual/Multi-lingual candidates preferred: English Advanced Spanish (Plus).
Solid understanding of the concept of risk-based decision-making (i.e. risk analysis, mitigation, resolution)
Ability to perform high-quality work, work with minimum supervision and deliver results in timely manner.
Must be able to communicate effectively regarding security, privacy, risk, and compliance to senior business leaders and fellow team members.
Able to draw upon proven experience to rapidly assimilate, understand, evaluate and recommend response actions to a variety of cyber events. He/she must be able to work with others in formal and ad-hoc team environments.
Demonstrated ability to configure, maintain and use core tools SPLUNK, Carbon Black or Fidelis.
This individual will have the proven ability to conduct event analysis and correlation; establish facts and deliver conclusions/recommendation under extremely short timelines.
Improve Bunge's outcomes by making data-driven decisions, keeping the customer at the forefront of all they do, and proactively gaining insight into the global strategy.
Collaborate, effectively communicate with others and take initiative to continually develop themselves.
Pursue opportunities to solve problems and take action while maintaining the ability to manage work, even in times of challenge or change.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Staff Product Designer para liderar a visão e a execução da nossa experiência de usuário para o app da Alice, olhando funcionalidades críticas como o atendimento médico digital. Você irá colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares — produto, engenharia, time de saúde, entre outros, para criar soluções encantadoras que ajudem a tornar as pessoas mais saudáveis. Nesta função, você terá a oportunidade de impulsionar e influenciar a estratégia de produto e design, impactando positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas.

Somos um time enxuto com alta densidade de talentos, onde cada um tem um papel relevante e um impacto enorme. Evitamos burocracia e lentidão na tomada de decisões — tornar o mundo mais saudável exige velocidade, qualidade e desejo de mudança, de criar algo original.

A pessoa candidata ideal é alguém capaz de analisar problemas complexos, multifacetados, e que consiga criar soluções inovadoras, com uma arquitetura de experiência e design visual elegantes, úteis e funcionais. Valorizamos o desejo de promover mudança com senso de urgência, conciliando qualidade com velocidade, equilibrando visão com experimentação. Um dia típico se parece com você discutindo o roadmap e a estratégia de produto com PMs, olhando métricas de experiência, criando hipóteses de soluções com protótipos e participando de design reviews e critiques com mais designers, ajudando a elevar a prática de disciplina como um todo dentro da Alice.

Responsabilidades

Liderar o design de ponta a ponta para as principais funcionalidades do app Alice, defendendo experiências centradas no usuário, desde o conceito inicial até o lançamento e demais evolução.

Definir e comunicar a visão de experiência, alinhada à estratégia de produto, garantindo um design consistente e envolvente que resolva dores reais das pessoas usuárias.

Colaborar ativamente com equipes de Produto, Engenharia e Pesquisa para definir metas, priorizar funcionalidades e entregar soluções eficazes de alta qualidade.

Orientar e apoiar outras pessoas designers, compartilhando boas práticas, revisando trabalhos e ajudando a elevar o nível de qualidade da equipe.

Ajudar a definir sucesso do ponto de vista de experiência, definindo métricas e resultados desejados para as soluções.

Criar e refinar protótipos para validar ideias e coletar feedback, usando insights qualitativos e quantitativos para embasar decisões de experiência.

Contribuir, evoluir e manter nosso sistema de design, garantindo consistência visual e de interação que seja escalável e inclusiva.

Promover acessibilidade, usabilidade e inclusão em todo o processo de design, buscando constantemente experiências funcionais que atendam às necessidades de todas as audiências.

O que estamos procurando em pessoas interessadas

Histórico comprovado na liderança de projetos complexos, atuando tanto na estratégia(definição do que fazer) quanto na execução(como é a experiência), em ambientes multidisciplinares.

Profundo conhecimento em métodos de design centrado no usuário: pesquisa, wireframes, prototipagem, testes e iteração.

Experiência na criação de protótipos interativos para comunicar conceitos.

Habilidade de fazer gestão de stakeholders e trabalhar de forma autônoma.

Seja curioso em como AI pode ajudar a produzir um design melhor, mais rápido.

Mentalidade estratégica e habilidade para equilibrar visão de longo prazo com atenção a detalhes — capaz tanto de idealizar grandes cenários quanto de refinar elementos de UI.

Excepcionais habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de influenciar e inspirar stakeholders de diferentes áreas.

Experiência com sistemas de design e na escalabilidade de padrões de design em múltiplas plataformas é um diferencial.

Paixão por liderar pelo exemplo, em vez de autoridade formal; você se realiza ao orientar e elevar outros(as) designers.

Modelo de trabalho

Para esta posição, sugerimos atuação híbrida, e é esperado que você vá pelo menos 2 vezes na semana ao nosso escritório. Nosso escritório é um lugar lindo e inspirador e fica na Av. Rebouças, 3535, em São Paulo, no bairro de Pinheiros. Se tiver curiosidade, só dar uma espiada aqui .

Na Alice, Design é uma disciplina unificada que inclui diferentes especialidades, como Product Design e Creative Design. Acreditamos que essa é a melhor forma de trazer consistência e manter uma visão integrada da nossa nossa experiência..


A especialidade de Product Design tem um papel fundamental na estratégia do negócio. Buscamos criar a melhor jornada possível com o produto e garantir o engajamento dos nossos membros. Dessa forma, quem usa Alice navega melhor pelo sistema de saúde, usa o serviço de forma eficiente e consequentemente se torna mais saudável. Isso reduz o nosso CAC (custo de aquisição) e o Care Cost (custo de servir saúde).

Oferecemos um pacote de compensation competitivo.

Para construir a melhor compensation, vamos equilibrar a sua experiência com o desafio da posição e time atual da Alice.

Nós estamos revolucionando o mercado de saúde no Brasil. Enquanto os comportamentos de consumo vêm evoluindo de forma acelerada, a experiência das pessoas com planos de saúde é a mesma de 20 anos atrás. Atritos, burocracia, demora para autorizar exames e para marcar consultas, reajustes exorbitantes. O plano é apenas um seguro financeiro reativo.

Somos um plano de saúde empresarial que sabe de saúde. Impulsionado por AI, garantimos que os nossos membros recebam o cuidado certo, no momento certo e no local certo. Proporcionamos uma jornada de saúde que é fácil de acessar, envolvente e extremamente confiável, realizando assim uma gestão proativa da saúde.

A Alice proporciona uma experiência de saúde integrada que já foi escolhida por mais de 8.000 empresas e é hoje o plano de mais de 45.000 pessoas. E esse número de empresas e membros não para de crescer, com nossa adição de membros tendo mais que triplicado quando comparamos de set-dez/23 para mai-set/24. Além disso, o nível de satisfação de nossos membros é 4,8/5 tanto com nosso atendimento 24 horas pelo app (Alice Agora) quanto com as consultas de nossos médicos especialistas. Isso é saúde como deve ser.

Junte-se a nós em nossa missão de tornar o mundo mais saudável. Você será parte fundamental na construção de um sistema de saúde mais sustentável que possa ser acessível para mais pessoas.

Na Alice, esperamos que você:

Trabalhe com paixão pelo propósito, fazendo da missão da Alice a sua missão;

Vá pra Arena e busque ser protagonista, desafiando o status-quo e tendo atitude e coragem de quem quer mudar;

Esteja subindo a barra e evoluindo todos os dias, para entregar o melhor que é possível sonhar;

Se importe com as pessoas, genuinamente, entendendo seus problemas com empatia e ajudando a resolvê-los;

Valorize trabalhar em um ambiente aberto, inclusivo e transparente, onde se possa ser quem verdadeiramente é;

Priorize a sua saúde e felicidade, afinal um time mais saudável gera mais valor.

Somos uma Healthtech fundada em 2019 com o propósito de tornar o mundo mais saudável; o que isso quer dizer, na prática, é que estamos trabalhando duro todos os dias para construir o que um sistema de saúde eficiente e humano deveriam ser.

Não é sobre usar tecnologia para um problema irrelevante ou pequeno, mas sim, repensar como a tecnologia deveria ser usada para gerar mais saúde e mais cuidado para as pessoas

Saúde está entre os maiores desafios da nossa geração: experiência subótima, baixos resultados na geração de saúde e custo exponencialmente crescente.

Alice é um novo capítulo em planos de saúde, implementando uma abordagem de cuidado coordenado e continuado, através de metodologias e tecnologias próprias, pensadas com o Membro no centro das decisões.

Para isso, buscamos um profissional que nos ajude, cada vez mais, a transformar vidas.

About Us

ZeroEx is scaling permanent carbon removal through enhanced rock weathering (ERW) projects in Germany, Brazil, and the United States. We license cutting-edge measurement tech that verifies every tonne sequestered, opening up the ERW industry to mining and agribusinesses ready to add an additional business model or decarbonize their core business.
Culture is the shadow of people—self-guided missiles who run on trust, ownership, and speed. If you thrive in ambiguity, lead from any seat, and care deeply about climate impact, you’ll feel at home here.

  • Safety-first mindset and basic HSE certification.

About The Role

As ERW Operations Manager, you will steer day-to-day field execution in Goiás, aligning ZeroEx, Anglo American, and local stakeholders. You’ll own logistics, schedules, and rapid troubleshooting so our science and sampling run like clockwork from August onward.


What You'll Do

  • Team & Project coordination: work closely with field teams, Anglo American and ZeroEx to align objectives, coordinate tasks, track progress and solve operational challenges.
  • Project Set-up & Planning: Develop and maintain logistics plans, including logistics workflows, documentation and reports
  • Field visits: Participate in field visits to understand execution challenges and improve coordination between planning and on-the-ground realities
  • Process improvement: contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes by integrating feedback and lessons learned to implement best practices.

Additional Responsibilities Will Include

  • Producing concise status reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Maintaining farmer relationships to secure ongoing field access.
  • Supporting MRV researchers with sampling schedules and data integrity checks.

What Makes ZeroEx Special?

  • Mission now, not 2050 – Each tonne removed is verified, permanent, and immediate.
  • On-ground autonomy – You’ll make real-time calls that shape ZeroEx Brazil large-scale ERW deployment.
  • Global tight-knit team – Join scientists, founders, and operators who move fast and keep egos low.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Apresentar-se devidamente uniformizado no período de trabalho e garantir o cumprimento deste item pela equipe de enfermagem (uniforme preestabelecido para o setor fechado);
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem, observando técnicas e procedimentos conforme as necessidades apresentadas e assegurando a conformidade dos processos de atendimentos aos pacientes;
  • Verificar o quadro clínico dos pacientes e as intercorrências do plantão anterior, a fim de prestar atendimento adequado aos pacientes, bem como assistir emergências apresentadas;
  • Acompanhar avaliações de quadros clínicos de pacientes, para melhor definição das ações de assistência a serem prestadas;
  • Percorrer os leitos e avaliar clinicamente os pacientes, prescrevendo cuidados de enfermagem e/ou requisitando a assistência de outros profissionais (médicos, nutricionistas, psicólogos) / Proceder registros relacionados ao Processo de Enfermagem;
  • Responder por procedimentos de enfermagem de maior complexidade tais como: passagem de sonda vesical de alívio e de demora, inserção de cateter epicutâneo, troca de curativo de feridas e acesso venoso central, dentre outros;
  • Proceder coleta de amostras de sangue arterial e venoso;
  • Realizar Scores de avaliação de gravidades de pacientes, de riscos assistenciais, dentre outros Scores preestabelecidos para o setor;
  • Rastrear, monitorar, prescrever e proceder aos cuidados relacionados aos procedimentos de risco: PICC, AVC, DVE, Tubos, Drenos e Sondas;
  • Definir e realizar junto à equipe de enfermagem procedimentos, de maior complexidade, referentes à assistência direta aos pacientes;
  • Acompanhar processos de administração de medicamentos via parenteral, principalmente nutrições parenterais e quimioterápicos, certificando a conformidade das operações;
  • Prestar suporte à equipe multidisciplinar na realização de procedimentos de maior complexidade, como: parada cardiorrespiratória, procedimentos invasivos, dentre outros;

  • Zelar para que as medidas de controle de infecções sejam seguidas corretamente, visando à redução dos índices de infecção relacionada à assistência em saúde;
  • Passar plantão, no leito do paciente, comunicando e esclarecendo intercorrências de forma detalhada, a fim de prestar a assistência necessária e adequada;
  • Relatar as intercorrências do plantão no prontuário e no relatório administrativo;
  • Preencher documentação específica do setor de forma correta a cada plantão: livro de presença, atos pessoais, anotações em ficha funcional, listas de treinamento, relatórios de avaliação do novo colaborador, entre outros;
  • Verificar diariamente as informações deixadas no relatório de gerência, cumprindo ações delegadas em tempo hábil e da forma solicitada;
  • Preencher relatório de alta e transferência, informando o quadro clínico do paciente, a fim de permitir a continuidade ao tratamento;
  • Verificar funcionamentos de equipamentos utilizados na assistência, mantendo informada a área responsável pelo processo de manutenção;
  • Participar das reuniões científicas do setor, visando manter-se atualizado quanto aos procedimentos da área;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e ministrar treinamentos de educação continuada e específica de três em três meses, visando a capacitação/qualificação da equipe;
  • Participar de reuniões com a Coordenação de Enfermagem, bem como de comissões específicas de trabalho, ex.: lesões cutâneas, nutrição enteral; infecção hospitalar e prontuários, dentre outras, visando a troca de informações e conhecimentos técnicos , soluções para ocorrências e alinhamento de ações;
  • Avaliar e identificar necessidades de manutenção e reposição de materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalar, hidráulico e hoteleiro, a fim de solicitar as providências necessárias;
  • Cumprir metas setoriais;
  • Realizar junto à coordenação a análise de resultados mensal, contribuindo e participando da elaboração de planos de ação para solução de problemas;
  • Divulgar, conscientizar e discutir junto à equipe de Técnicos de Enfermagem os resultados alcançados, capacitando-a para a execução dos planos de ação;
  • Responder tecnicamente pela área quando necessário estando devidamente habilitado. - Executar outras tarefas correlatas e do mesmo grau de dificuldade, mediante solicitação do superior imediato.

description:
We’re not looking for someone to “analyze” People data.

We’re looking for someone to reprogram how humans and intelligent systems grow together .

Welcome to the People Intelligence Lab — CloudWalk’s experimental playground where People, AI, and Data collide to create what doesn’t exist (yet).

You’ll build tools, agents, and experiences that augment human potential. You’ll break things that no longer make sense. You’ll make the invisible visible — and occasionally, turn clarity into creative chaos.

This is not an HR job. This is for human+AI hacker potential .


What you’ll actually do:
  • Design and prototype AI copilots , LLM-powered flows , and smart systems that boost how we learn, hire, evolve, and collaborate.
  • Dive into People data (culture, performance, engagement, feedback) and make it speak through dashboards, bots, agents, and stories.
  • Build experimental tools that rethink how we run rituals, feedback, performance cycles, and people ops.
  • Prototype fast. Test in the wild. Iterate in public.
  • Bring context, emotion, and meaning to AI tools. We’re not here to replace humans — we’re here to amplify them .
  • Hack. Document. Share. Break. Rebuild. Repeat.
What we’re looking for:
  • You speak Python as a second language (or want to), and you’re not afraid to ask ChatGPT to help .
  • You’ve played with APIs, LLMs, LangChain, or other AI playgrounds — or you’re dying to learn.
  • You understand People & Culture enough to break its logic from the inside .
  • You can think in systems, but love messy humans.
  • You’re a builder, not just a thinker — and your GitHub, Notion, or Miro boards prove it.
  • You’ve got opinions. And curiosity. And you’re allergic to bureaucracy.
  • You’re fascinated by AI — not to automate people out, but to elevate what makes us human .
Bonus XP if you:
  • Have built bots, microtools, copilots, or dashboards that solve real problems (even for yourself).
  • Have worked at the edge of people, product, and systems — even better if things were on fire.
  • Are obsessed with learning — especially about learning itself.
What you WON`T find here:
  • Endless alignment meetings.
  • People waiting to be told what to do.
  • Rigid hierarchies.
  • Process for process’ sake.
  • Vanilla HR.
What you will find:
  • Freedom to build and ship things fast
  • People who ask “why not?” more than “why?”
  • High trust, high expectation, high curiosity
  • Space to explore what happens when humans + machines design work together.

If this sounds like a call to adventure — it probably is.

We’re not building for today. We’re prototyping tomorrow .

Apply if you’re weird enough to fit in.

title: Dental Product Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Product Manager, Dental role at Guardian Life

Join to apply for the Product Manager, Dental role at Guardian Life

The Dental Product Manager plays a key role in developing, supporting, implementing and managing our dental insurance products to meet market needs, drive growth, and enhance member value. This role champions innovation by identifying and implementing forward-thinking solutions that differentiate our dental product portfolio while serving as the product subject matter expert, working cross-functionally with underwriting, sales, marketing, digital, legal, state filing, compliance, government relations and clinical teams to ensure product competitiveness, compliance and success. The areas of focus for this role includes, but is not limited to: business case development, supporting the development and implementation of the dental products and services, defining and overseeing the go-to-market activities, and supporting all current/inforce dental products, services and capabilities.
You Will:

  • Contribute to the development of a clear product vision and roadmap that is aligned with Guardian’s goals and objectives.
  • Assess key market factors, including competitive landscape, consumer and policyholder insights, and unmet customer needs to identify areas of opportunity for differentiated dental product or service enhancements to meet customer expectations and achieve growth for Guardian.
  • Support monitoring and participating in industry trade groups, meetings and other activities and sharing key learnings with all internal stakeholders.
  • Accountability for monitoring KPIs to ensure proper adoption and performance outcomes are achieved.
  • Work independently but also collaborates with the rest of the product managers and matrix partners to identify opportunities and deliver on shared initiatives.
  • Communicate effectively by articulating information in a manner that is easily understood, both internally and externally, across all levels of the organization and in large public forums.
  • Support negotiations with vendor partners, and influences stakeholders across multiple teams and departments.
  • Execute product management processes throughout the product lifecycle, including product development, roadmap planning, and launch activities.
  • Ensure that procedures and systems are updated as necessary and that changes are communicated to all interested parties.
  • Conduct regular market research and analysis to keep abreast of trends and adapt to the ever-changing market environment.
  • Deliver and present reports, product plans, and competitive analyses to internal stakeholders.
  • Support the development of compelling presentations and documentation. This includes representing Guardian in Thought Leadership webinars and speaking engagements, broker meetings and roadshows, industry associations, etc.
  • Responsible for developing and delivering product training and communication—both internally and externally—to ensure clear, consistent, and accurate messaging that supports the value proposition and effectively educates distribution partners and key stakeholders on product positioning.
You Have:
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in product management, preferably in claims, account management, implementation, and/or product management.
  • Direct dental group insurance experience.
  • The ability to contribute to the development of a clear product vision and translate that vision into actionable product roadmaps.Produces clear supporting documents in PowerPoint, Excel, etc.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to effectively handle multiple priorities.
  • Fosters a high level of teamwork and collaboration between employees, teams, across departments and the field as appropriate.
  • Possesses excellent organizational skills.
  • Exhibits analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable using metrics and data to form insights, guide decisions, and measure success.
  • Project management experience with a track record of delivering results on time and within budget.
  • Experience working within a matrixed environment and contributing to cross-functional teams.
  • Entrepreneurial – ability to work independently and under pressure; ability to bring clarity to ideas that may appear unclear or ambiguous in concept.
  • Exhibits financial acumen, analytical skills, ability to analyze and communicate financial information, and support business case development.
  • Knowledge of Agile and Lean product development methodologies.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, computer science, marketing science or related fields.
Location:
  • Preferred locations: Bethlehem, PA; Boston, MA; or New York, NY
  • Hybrid work arrangement (3+ days in office per week)
  • Approximately 20% travel with the position
Salary Range:
$77,570.00 - $127,430.00
The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. Descrição e Responsabilidades

Monitorar as atividades no canteiro de obras para assegurar que todas as operações sigam as legislações ambientais vigentes.

Supervisionar a correta segregação, armazenamento e destinação de resíduos gerados durante a obra, incluindo resíduos sólidos e líquidos.

Monitorar a qualidade do ar, ruído e emissões atmosféricas, assegurando que estejam dentro dos limites estabelecidos pelas normas ambientais.

Garantir a aplicação de medidas de controle ambiental no local da obra, como contenção de erosão, controle de sedimentos, proteção de recursos hídricos, e minimização de impactos em áreas sensíveis.

Acompanhar o uso de recursos naturais na obra, como água e energia, visando a redução de desperdícios e a eficiência no consumo.

Elaborar relatórios periódicos para o acompanhamento de indicadores ambientais e para a comunicação com órgãos reguladores e gestores de projeto.

Apoiar no processo de licenciamento ambiental da obra, acompanhando as condicionantes impostas pelos órgãos fiscalizadores e garantindo o cumprimento das mesmas.

Participar de auditorias ambientais e fiscalizações de órgãos reguladores, colaborando na implementação de ações corretivas ou preventivas quando necessário.

Realizar treinamentos e ações de conscientização ambiental com os operários e equipes de obra, incentivando o cumprimento das práticas ambientais e de segurança.

Atuar em situações de emergência ambiental, como vazamentos de substâncias perigosas, auxiliando na contenção e mitigação de impactos.

Manter a documentação ambiental da obra atualizada e organizada, incluindo licenças, autorizações, relatórios e registros de auditoria.

Requisitos

Formação Técnica em Meio Ambiente, Saneamento cursando ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência em obras de construção civil ou grandes projetos de infraestrutura.

Conhecimento em legislação ambiental, normas de segurança e saúde no trabalho aplicadas ao meio ambiente.

Habilidade na gestão de resíduos e controle de poluição em canteiros de obras.

Experiência na elaboração de relatórios técnicos e no cumprimento de condicionantes ambientais.

Disponibilidade para atuar em campo e em diferentes projetos de obras.

description:
The Role:

We're looking for an experienced credit research analyst to join our Debtwire Credit Research Team. The team provides unique insights and valuation analysis on companies and their securities that are restructuring, in the process of a transforming event or raising capital. Key tasks will include reviewing financial statements and legal documents to produce detailed credit research on stressed, distressed, and restructuring companies. The analysis will be produced in reports produced for subscribers of Debtwire, an ION Analytics subsidiary.

You will have the option to work remotely, including a flexible contract and competitive rates.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Produce Credit Reports that provide financial and valuation analysis on high-yield, distressed and stressed companies.
  • Interact with subscribers electronically and personally to discuss credit and macro analysis.
  • Along with creating credit research, the candidate will assist in special reports and ad-hoc projects.
  • Interact with management and IR teams of companies covered. Attend conferences and company investor day as needed.
Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications
  • The candidate should have 5+ years as either a credit or equity analyst.
  • Naturally curious and driven to figure out how to analyze complex situations and be tenacious in obtaining information.
  • Excellent understanding of financial statements: income statement, balance sheet and cash flows and the drive to thoroughly read the information supporting the financial statements.
  • A thorough understanding of debt and equity securities and the markets they trade in is required, including some knowledge of bankruptcy processes.
  • Valuation experience including waterfall, and DCF analysis is required.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of fixed income analytics (ie Z-spread, duration).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish (both strongly preferred).
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Excel and Word
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to build a thesis and reach a conclusion in a structured manner, are required.
  • Experience writing reports in English.
  • Ability to work in a team-based environment, with a sense of teamwork and cooperation
  • Ability to manage workflow under strict deadlines

About us

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

• Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading and risk.

• Over 800 of the world’s leading banks and broker-dealers use our electronic trading platforms to operate the world’s financial market infrastructure.

ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group with 13,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe. Our ever-expanding global footprint, cutting edge products, and over 40,000 customers worldwide provide an unparalleled career experience for those who share our vision.

ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.

ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.

The Role

Ensures strong relationships with client, regulators, captive directors and key service providers.Primary focus on financial statement review and/or preparation. Works as part of the Client Service Team, as well as interacts with clients, prospects, regulators and external service providers.

Specific Responsibilities:

Insurance

  • Liaison with insurance broker and reinsurance brokers as required.
  • Assist with underwriting documentation and decisions in conjunction with the Client Service Team and the Practice Underwriting resources, as appropriate.
  • Monitoring of exposures and risk transfer pricing within assigned portfolio.
  • Obtain regulatory approval for changes to the business plan.
  • Obtain Board approval for underwriting decisions.

Finance/Regulatory

  • Obtaining regulatory approval of changes to business plan

  • Liaise with and monitor investment managers in respect of invested funds
  • Assist Client Service Team with co-ordination of board meetings
  • Ensure timely production and accuracy of board papers.
  • Ensure timely production of minutes and review prior to distribution.
  • Action matters arising from client meetings
  • Ensure relevant company secretarial functions are performed in a timely manner.
  • Ensure compliance with Corporate Governance.

Management

  • To assist in providing input on strategic and operational issues. Assume responsibility for a specific area of company strategy.
  • To assist in implement policies adopted by Practice
  • Contact is maintained with all client directors and that they are advised of any developments.
  • Keep Practice leadership apprised of client developments.
  • Entertain clients & prospects as required.
  • Support Senior Management in performing board insight, perspective & thought leadership as required
  • Understands importance of Internal Control procedures and the WTW code of Conduct and works to be seen as a role model in the office.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • 4-year degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent work experience, or related area or CPA qualification
  • Advanced Computer Skills
  • In depth knowledge and experience of captive insurance and insurance industry in the following areas:(1) accounting for captives (2) insurance products, and (3) problem resolution

  • Ability to monitor quality control
  • Client relationship skills
  • Project Management skills
  • Board meeting presentation skills
  • Working toward Leadership and People Management skills
  • Compliance
  • Can solve complex issues and will raise highly complex issues to higher level
  • Ability to influence and negotiate
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.
Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $80,000.00-$130,000.00 USDannually.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.
Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)

Street Diligence Inc. is seeking a dynamic Software Engineering Team Lead to drive the development of high-quality software solutions. This role is ideal for a seasoned engineer with hands-on experience in large web applications & moderate codebases. You should have a solid grasp of modern programming design patterns. You will lead a talented team of engineers, ensuring sprint assignments are efficiently executed while providing technical guidance and architectural vision. Your expertise in architecting scalable solutions will be key to our continued innovation and success.
What You'll Do
Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Team Guidance: Participate in providing technical guidance to software engineers, ensuring that sprint tasks are well-defined, prioritized, and completed on schedule.
  • Code Quality: Conduct regular code reviews and enforce best practices to maintain a robust, clean, and sustainable codebase.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Lead regular technical discussions and workshops to foster continuous learning and development among team members.
Architecture & Design
  • Solution Architecture: Help to design and architect scalable, high-performance solutions that meet both current and future business needs.
  • Design Patterns: Apply and promote proven programming design patterns and best practices across projects, ensuring consistency and maintainability in complex codebases.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Cross-functional Coordination: Work closely with UX/UI designers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to integrate feedback and align on project goals.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring transparency and shared understanding across the organization.
What You'll Bring To The Table
Education & Experience:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development, with a proven track record in a leadership or team lead role.
Technical Skills:
  • Experience working with large or complex codebases and a deep understanding of programming design patterns.
  • Proven experience in architecting scalable software solutions.
  • Strong understanding of web application development and modern web design patterns.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Ruby, C#, Java, JavaScript) and familiarity with full-stack development concepts.
  • Strong background in agile development methodologies and continuous integration practices.
Additional Skills:
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for building innovative solutions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively mentor and support team members.
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards of code quality, including unit testing and behavior-driven development practices.
This role is a unique opportunity to drive technical excellence, and to help contribute to the evolution of our software architecture. If you’re passionate about engineering leadership and ready to take on new challenges, we encourage you to apply.
We know that not everyone will meet all of the qualifications listed above. If your experience doesn't perfectly align, but you believe you'd be a strong fit for the team, we encourage you to apply. We’re eager to learn more about what you can offer!

Desenvolver comercialmente os clientes dos canais Indireto (Distribuidores e Atacados), g arantindo a execução da estratégia de nossas marcas, com muito foco externo em Sell out.

Suas responsabilidades

• Desenvolver e implementar calendários promocionais com foco em sell out (e sell in), para todas as categorias da companhia;

Com a inclusão no centro de tudo o que fazemos, trabalhando em conjunto com os nossos Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), apoiamos os nossos colaboradores em cada etapa da sua jornada profissional, ajudando-os a ter sucesso à sua maneira individual.

Sabemos que, nem sempre, se tem todos os requisitos pedidos para uma posição.
