title: Engenheiro de Telecom Sênior
description:
Desde 1948, a Andrade Gutierrez vem ajudando a construir e a desenvolver o Brasil. Desde então, a empresa tem participado de algumas das obras mais importantes da história de nosso país. Construímos o desenvolvimento de uma sociedade e inovamos todos os dias na forma de pensar e de fazer engenharia.
A Andrade Gutierrez se destaca como uma das maiores empresas de engenharia da América Latina e nossa trajetória tem sido marcada pela busca por novas oportunidades e grandes desafios.
Nosso desenvolvimento acontece de forma sustentável e está apoiado em pilares como qualidade, responsabilidade socioambiental e segurança no trabalho. Nossas unidades de engenharia e construção são focadas em projetos de Infraestrutura, Energia, Mobilidade e Indústria, com ênfase na excelência operacional.
Se você é focado em processos, é flexível e se adapta às mudanças, e anseia por trabalhar em uma multinacional em expansão, aqui é o seu lugar!
Na Andrade Gutierrez todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia ou deficiência.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responder pelo dimensionamento e especificação de equipamentos para Sistemas de Telecomunicações para plantas industriais, como: Redes de Dados (Operativa e Corporativa), Sistema de CFTV, Sistema de Segurança Patrimonial e Controle de Acesso.
  • Dimensionar, planejar e especificar redes de telecomunicações que atendam às necessidades específicas das obras industriais, considerando fatores como tipo de comunicação, segurança, custo de implantação e eficiência.
  • Estimar quantitativos de materiais e equipamentos, para Propostas Técnicas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outras equipes de Engenharia e com área de Suprimentos a fim de consolidar informações e assegurar que todos os aspectos da proposta sejam abordados de forma integrada.
  • Analisar proposta técnicas de fornecedores com o objetivo de validar que o ofertado está de acordo com as necessidades dos empreendimentos.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Desejável formação acadêmica completa em Engenharias com Especialização em Telecom.
  • Conhecimento de topologias de rede, especificação de fibras-ópticas, especificação de equipamentos como switches, firewall, roteador, access point, racks, distribuidores ópticos, câmeras de CFTV, segurança critica, controle de acesso, telefonia IP.
  • Experiência com elaboração das diferentes fases de projeto: Conceitual, Básico, Executivo.
  • Experiência em tratativas com fornecedores de equipamentos, elaboração de parecer técnico de propostas e verificação de documento de fornecedores.
  • Experiência em verificação e fiscalização de projetos.
  • Experiência e vivência em Obras Industriais.

Informações adicionais
  • Local de Trabalho: Região da Berrini (Zona Sul) - São Paulo/SP (100% presencial no escritório).

Amazon is seeking a talented, self-directed senior Account Based Marketing (ABM) professional to join our AWS Marketing team in Brazil. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting, fast growing business.
Key job responsibilities
Designing and implementing end-to-end ABM strategies for high-value accounts in the Brazilian market, partnering with sales teams to create personalized marketing campaigns aligned with account objectives, developing targeted content and programs for decision-makers across industries. It is also responsibility: tracking and optimizing campaign performance using data-driven insights, collaborating with cross-functional teams, acting as primary marketing contact with sales teams and leaders through participation in account plannings, sales calls, meetings and Quarter Business Reviews.
A day in the life

  • Design and implement end-to-end ABM strategies targeting high-value accounts in the Brazilian market
  • Partner with sales teams to create personalized marketing campaigns that align with account objectives and drive business outcomes
  • Develop targeted content and programs that resonate with decision-makers across different industries
  • Track, measure, and optimize ABM campaign performance using data-driven insights
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent messaging and customer experience
  • Develop a deep understanding of the business and act as primarily marketing contact with sales team and leaders, including regular participation in sales team calls, in-person meetings and Quarter Business Reviews.
  • Leverage global marketing resources to fill sales requirements and find ways to invent and simplify to address sales needs without large budgets.
  • Earn trust and maintain strong relationships with Field Sales, Pre-sales, and Solution Architects teams to support their goals, working in conjunction with other marketing leaders in your geography and with peers in the corporate office in the US, increasing engagement with marketing and drive program support.
About The Team
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Basic Qualifications
  • 3+ years of proven track record of successfully running ABM campaigns for large B2B companies
  • Experience in enterprise technology marketing, preferably in cloud computing or generative artificial intelligence
  • Strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle and enterprise customer journey
  • Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
  • Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills (English and Portuguese) with an innate attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams and agency partners
  • Demonstrated problem solving capabilities in a complex business environment.
  • Ability to make data-driven decisions quickly with a bias for action.
  • Ability to work independently and autonomously.
  • A strong team player – comfortable and motivated working in a collaborative environment, with the ability to build relationships with key stakeholders – field marketing, global marketing and sales teams.

Digital Solution Architect for IoT based Applications

Join to apply for the Digital Solution Architect for IoT based Applications role at TK Elevator .

What we expect

TK Elevator aims to be a leader in industrial IoT solutions, data-enabled software solutions that make our customers and users successful and happy. In collaboration with leading technology companies as strategic partners, we have recently launched our first Digital Native Elevator EOX. Our goal is to continue improving the lives of people everywhere, every day.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Digital Solution Architect to support our digital product teams. Your responsibilities include designing and evolving scalable, secure, and maintainable applications, defining target architectures, documenting current systems, and guiding development teams in best practices across the software development lifecycle.

You will collaborate with product owners and development teams to ensure our application frameworks are robust, future-proof, and aligned with business goals. You will be part of a dynamic, global team using leading technology to solve challenging problems and develop new business solutions and digital products.

  • Application Architecture Leadership: Define and evolve target architecture for digital applications. Provide guidance and oversight during implementation. Conduct design reviews and code walkthroughs.
  • Architecture Documentation: Create and maintain architecture diagrams, data flows, interface definitions, and integration points.
  • Solution Design: Collaborate with product teams to design end-to-end solutions ensuring architectural consistency and scalability.
  • Development Process Enablement: Support teams in establishing best practices in software design, modularization, code quality, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, monitoring, and operational readiness.
  • Security & Compliance: Incorporate cybersecurity best practices throughout the development lifecycle.

Who are we looking for

  • Education: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years in solution or application architecture, with proven experience in cloud-native applications, microservices, event-driven architectures, API-first design, and cloud platforms like Azure. Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams.
  • Architectural and Technical Skills: Strong experience with architecture modeling tools (UML), managing non-functional requirements, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, containerization, and programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript. Familiarity with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, messaging systems like Kafka or MQTT, monitoring tools like Grafana, and security standards (OAuth2, OpenID).
  • Soft Skills: Analytical problem-solving, excellent communication, pragmatic, hands-on approach, team-oriented, and goal-driven.

What we offer

Health care, dental care, bonus, private pension, support programs for pregnant women, social support, life insurance, telemedicine, nutrition and psychology services, restaurant, transportation.

About Us

People are at the heart of TK Elevator. We prioritize teamwork, safety, and a shared vision to keep the world moving. Join us to impact urban mobility's future.

Additional Information

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Employment type: Full-time

description:

System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a System Software Engineer for Ubuntu Networking
Our growing investment in Ubuntu now enables us to hire a group of outstanding systems software engineers to focus on the connectivity of Ubuntu in a wide range of circumstances, from cloud to server to desktop and IoT. We would like to strengthen the tooling, services, documentation, robustness, security and clarity of Linux network abstractions to provide fast, reliable and secure connections for Ubuntu.
The network stack is one of the most critical aspects of any operating system where stability, reliability and uptime are paramount. Its ease of use and reliability contribute to Ubuntu's success from IoT, Desktop, Server to the Cloud. We are expanding our Foundations team to focus our efforts on this essential function and are looking for people passionate about lower level technologies involved in an operating system's network stack. Applicants will be comfortable discussing bridges, bonds, routing, DNS resolution and other technologies used to interconnect modern operating systems. We'll work with a very wide range of upstream components and communities covering a wide range of connectivity tech. We might touch the kernel, iwd, networkmanager, wpa_supplicant, bluetooth stacks, conman, mobile data stacks, ethernet, infiniband, network virtualisation capabilities, VPNs and offload to smartnics. We model Ubuntu connectivity with Netplan and will continue to drive this forward as the easiest and most effective central tool to enable connectivity everywhere.
The Ubuntu Foundations Team delivers and maintains the core of the Ubuntu system, the base for the entire Ubuntu family of products and services. Ubuntu strives to deliver the latest and best free software components, in an easy to use and highly reliable form. We build on the technical excellence of Debian and bring additional focus and shape to the solutions we offer industry.
As a Linux System Engineer, you will maintain and integrate core components involved in the network stack of the Ubuntu Distribution. You will be discussing design with other team members, upstream projects, mentor less senior engineers and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAS region
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data center architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organization
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape innovative product strategies
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Deep understanding and passion for Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Professional experience with computer networks, including virtual networks, distributed systems as well as understanding of hardware offloading technologies.
  • Interest in systemd-networkd, NetworkManager, ModemManager, iwd, conman, bluez, iproute2, Open vSwitch, WireGuard and similar software components
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Interest in packaging software for Debian and Ubuntu
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are passionate, curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Languages

Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.

Experience

  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

Be part of a company that is redefining the future of mining by focusing on sustainability, safety, and social responsibility. At FLS, your engineering expertise helps solve real-world challenges and contributes to greener, more efficient mineral processing.
About FLS And Our Votorantim Facility
FLS is a global leader in sustainable technology and services for the mining industry. Our Votorantim site in Brazil is a critical hub for our Latin American operations, offering laboratory services, pilot testing, process optimization, and technical support for solid/liquid separation equipment and mineral processing solutions. As part of our global R&D and technical services network, this facility plays a pivotal role in shaping future-ready mining processes.
We believe that diversity drives innovation and performance. At FLS, you'll collaborate with colleagues from around the world, developing sustainable solutions that leave a positive impact on people, the environment, and the communities where we operate.
Role Summary
The Process Laboratory Engineer is responsible for leading, performing, and supporting laboratory and pilot-scale testing of solid/liquid separation processes. This role is key in providing technical expertise to internal and external stakeholders, ensuring correct equipment sizing, process performance, and customer satisfaction. The engineer will work cross-functionally with Sales, R&D, Product Engineering, and Site Services to ensure world-class delivery and technical excellence.
Purpose of the Role
To act as a technical authority in sedimentation and filtration processes, overseeing the preparation, execution, and reporting of laboratory tests that support equipment design, performance validation, and process optimization. The Process Laboratory Engineer contributes directly to successful project delivery, technical proposals, commissioning support, and innovation in mineral processing.
Key Responsibilities
Laboratory Testing & Analysis

  • Plan and execute laboratory and pilot-scale testing programs for thickening, filtration, and clarification processes.
  • Analyse test results to determine equipment type, size, and optimal operating conditions.
  • Prepare comprehensive reports and recommendations for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Maintain lab equipment in optimal condition, ensuring safety and testing accuracy.
Technical Expertise & Process Support
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in solid/liquid separation across FLSmidth business lines.
  • Read and interpret PFDs, P&IDs, technical specifications, and layout drawings.
  • Support flowsheet development and product selection for mineral processing projects.
  • Assist in commissioning activities, troubleshooting and performance validation onsite.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with global teams, including Sales, Product Engineering, and Project Execution.
  • Guide junior engineers and technicians in lab procedures, data interpretation, and documentation.
  • Participate in customer meetings to explain test methodology, results, and process selection rationale.
Project and Data Management
  • Manage multiple testing projects, ensuring timelines, quality, and accuracy.
  • Document each testing program from proposal to final report.
  • Support continuous improvement of lab processes and data management practices.
Thought Leadership
  • Present findings in internal technical meetings and contribute to published technical papers.
  • Stay up to date on advances in filtration and sedimentation technologies.
  • Represent FLSmidth at conferences or client meetings as needed.
Qualifications And Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Mineral Processing or related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in mining, mineral processing or chemical industries with solid/liquid separation background preferred.
  • Previous laboratory, pilot plant, or field commissioning experience highly desirable.
  • Strong data analysis and reporting skills, including use of statistical tools.
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese (oral and written).
  • Familiarity with occupational safety practices in lab and field environments.
  • Must have legal work authorization in Brazil.
Behavioural Traits
  • Proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong interpersonal and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
  • Effective communicator, both written and verbal.
  • Committed to safety, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Job Title:

Sr. Manager, Business Information Security Officer (BISO)

Job Description

Concentrix Corporation is seeking a Brazil Business Information Security Officer to join the Global Security team reporting to the CNX MET GEO Business Information Security Officer – Insider Risk and Compliance team.

The Brazil Business Information Security Officer (BISO) focuses on proactively identifying security and compliance issues/risks to business operation processes in various accounts, drives in executing the controls to deter, detect and mitigate security and insider risks - including establishing capability and mechanisms to monitor and audit information and data protection of both Concentrix and clients as well as compliance level of each process and relevant control item as deployed in the operational environment, The country BISO drives proactively to enhance the fraud and compliance prevention culture and risk-free environment in Concentrix as well as identifies issues that would include but not limited to physical and logical security, data privacy, KPI, CSAT, inbound/outbound calls manipulation, information leakage, etc. impacting business. Typical activities include but are not limited to Risk Management – risk identification, risk assessments, support in development of risk action plans, risk closures, supporting investigations - case documentation, written first-hand reports, involve in-person or remote interview of persons of interest and working outside normal business hours etc., Governance and metrics, Executive presentations, Collaboration with all teams/ departments. Achieves results through direct interaction as well as influencing other internal groups or persons to achieve results.

Qualifications:


• 7 to 10 years of experience working in risk and compliance management, internal security controls, internal/external security assessment or audit, internal or cyber incident investigations.

Advanced English Level is a MUST, Spanish will be a plus
• Bachelor's/ Masters’ Degree in Information Technology or relevant areas.
• CISA certified or willing/able to certify within 12 months of employment.
• Experience in the BPO industry working in quality, security compliance or delivery strongly preferred.
• Deep understanding of BPO Business Operation and CRM services delivery processes.
• Understanding fraud, process non-compliance and incident investigations as well as various risks in the BPO industry.
• Ability to identify performance and opportunity gaps.
• Detail oriented with excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.
• Ability to effectively communicate findings to senior team members with appropriate recommendation and action plan raised to address the gaps in an effective & efficient manner.

BISO Responsibilities:


• Drive the highest Integrity and Ethical standards across the staff and the accounts in scope.
• Provide governance to operations management team and Quality Assurance team for effective and efficient surveillance and monitoring towards pro-active security and business process non-compliance issue identification.
• Collaborate with respective supporting functions/departments (IT, HR, Facility, Legal, DPO, etc.) to address relevant security issues/risks.
• Perform internal audit/assessment on regular basis based on different business process compliance management and risk control mechanisms in different accounts to ensure the full compliance as per relevant standard and identify potential issues/risks.
• Work closely with the operation team to get all identified non-compliance items fixed in a timely manner to drive for closure and proactively propose and deploy extra preventive controls where appropriate.
• Establish and execute a robust methodology for periodic reviews aiming to highlight the gaps that exist in the operational processes.
o Analyze operational data to identify trends, root causes of business issues, and/or opportunities.
o Provide recommendations for corrective and preventive actions and suggest improvements to the processes.
o Review and report the results and present to management team.
• Ensure partnership with accounts management team for Proactive Compliance Risk Management – identification, assessment, risk action planning, and closures.
• Coordinate and support Global Security Assessments (GSAs) - a holistic assessment (technology, HR, operations, finance, etc.) of risks being faced by delivery operations and No Notice Inspections (NNIs) conducted against the specific accounts in scope.
• Participate and involve in assigned investigations.
• Conduct incidents analytics for assigned areas within the defined timelines.
• Drive incidents to closure in a timely manner as required.
• Document learnings from incidents and circulate to relevant stakeholders Work with Client Risk Control Team directly as the security SPOC from CNX.
• Conduct employee awareness and assist in developing training materials and where necessary assist in specific training.

Accountability:
• Ensure the security and business process compliance in various accounts to meet business and client expectation.
• Continuously improve the compliance level driven by operational requirement and business growth.
• Partner/support the country BISO with the completion of various security programs/initiatives in the concerned accounts driven by Insider Risk and Compliance team, including but not limited to the GSA and NNI.

title: Planejador de Manutenção Pleno
description:
A General Mills está comprometida em ser uma força do bem por meio de uma estratégia global de inclusão para levar diversidade às nossas pessoas e cultura, possibilitando maiores níveis de envolvimento com nossos colaboradores para crescermos junto com nossos clientes e consumidores.
Para nós, criar um ambiente inclusivo e fomentar a diversidade impulsiona o crescimento da companhia, além de dar suporte para o crescimento de nossos colaboradores.

Objetivo do Cargo

Garantir o planejamento, programação e controle das atividades de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, visando à máxima disponibilidade dos ativos, otimização de recursos e cumprimento das normas de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente, custos.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Elaborar planos e cronogramas de manutenção preventiva e preditiva, com base nas recomendações dos fabricantes, histórico de falhas e estratégias de confiabilidade.
  • Programar paradas de manutenção corretiva e preventiva junto às áreas operacionais, minimizando impactos na produção.
  • Analisar ordens de serviço, definindo recursos necessários (mão de obra, peças, ferramentas e tempo).
  • Coordenar backlog de manutenção, priorizando atividades conforme criticidade dos ativos.
  • Acompanhar e revisar planos de manutenção no sistema informatizado (ex.: SAP PM).
  • Garantir o abastecimento de materiais e componentes necessários para execução dos serviços.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a equipe de manutenção em diagnósticos de falhas e melhorias nos equipamentos.
  • Desenvolver indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, aderência ao plano) e propor ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Contribuir para a definição de estratégias de confiabilidade e gestão de ativos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade durante os processos de manutenção.
  • Atuar como interface entre manutenção, produção, PCM e áreas de suporte.
  • Efetuar controle dos custos de manutenção, garantindo a entrega do Budget anual.
  • Efetuar lançamentos de notas fiscais de peças e serviços.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência anterior em planejamento de manutenção industrial.
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (SAP).
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de planejamento e controle de manutenção (PCM).
  • Interpretação de desenhos técnicos e manuais de equipamentos.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de falhas (FMEA, RCA, 5 Porquês).
  • Experiência com indicadores de performance de manutenção.
  • Conhecimento em Normas de segurança e regulamentações aplicáveis (NRs).
  • Organização e foco em resultados.
  • Capacidade analítica.
  • Proatividade e visão sistêmica.
  • Comunicação assertiva e trabalho em equipe.
  • Liderança técnica.

Descrição da Empresa

A General Mills é uma empresa líder global em alimentos e trabalha para fazer os alimentos que o mundo ama! Nossas marcas globais incluem Cheerios, Annie's, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Häagen-Dazs, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Old El Paso, Wanchai Ferry, Yoki, Blue e muitas outras. Com sede em Minneapolis, Minnesota, EUA, a companhia chegou ao Brasil em 1997, quando iniciou as vendas do sorvete premium Häagen-Dazs. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. Somos hoje um time apaixonado de 35 mil colaboradores em mais de 100 países e em todos os continentes.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a System Software Engineer for Ubuntu Networking
Our growing investment in Ubuntu now enables us to hire a group of outstanding systems software engineers to focus on the connectivity of Ubuntu in a wide range of circumstances, from cloud to server to desktop and IoT. We would like to strengthen the tooling, services, documentation, robustness, security and clarity of Linux network abstractions to provide fast, reliable and secure connections for Ubuntu.
The network stack is one of the most critical aspects of any operating system where stability, reliability and uptime are paramount. Its ease of use and reliability contribute to Ubuntu's success from IoT, Desktop, Server to the Cloud. We are expanding our Foundations team to focus our efforts on this essential function and are looking for people passionate about lower level technologies involved in an operating system's network stack. Applicants will be comfortable discussing bridges, bonds, routing, DNS resolution and other technologies used to interconnect modern operating systems. We'll work with a very wide range of upstream components and communities covering a wide range of connectivity tech. We might touch the kernel, iwd, networkmanager, wpa_supplicant, bluetooth stacks, conman, mobile data stacks, ethernet, infiniband, network virtualisation capabilities, VPNs and offload to smartnics. We model Ubuntu connectivity with Netplan and will continue to drive this forward as the easiest and most effective central tool to enable connectivity everywhere.
The Ubuntu Foundations Team delivers and maintains the core of the Ubuntu system, the base for the entire Ubuntu family of products and services. Ubuntu strives to deliver the latest and best free software components, in an easy to use and highly reliable form. We build on the technical excellence of Debian and bring additional focus and shape to the solutions we offer industry.
As a Linux System Engineer, you will maintain and integrate core components involved in the network stack of the Ubuntu Distribution. You will be discussing design with other team members, upstream projects, mentor less senior engineers and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAS region
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data center architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organization
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape innovative product strategies
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Deep understanding and passion for Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Professional experience with computer networks, including virtual networks, distributed systems as well as understanding of hardware offloading technologies.
  • Interest in systemd-networkd, NetworkManager, ModemManager, iwd, conman, bluez, iproute2, Open vSwitch, WireGuard and similar software components
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Interest in packaging software for Debian and Ubuntu
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are passionate, curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Gerente de Cadeias de Valor
description:
Posição: Gerente de Cadeias de Valor

Programa /Departamento : Florestas e Uso d a Terra

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo/SP

Esta posição está atualmente hospedada pelo WRI Brasil, dentro do Programa de Florestas e Uso da Terra. O WRI trabalha para desenvolver soluções que garantam a segurança alimentar de 10 bilhões de pessoas até 2050, reduzindo as emissões de gases de efeito estufa, combatendo a perda de florestas e aliviando a pobreza.

O WRI Brasil busca uma pessoa para atuar como Gerente de Cadeias de Valor, liderando iniciativas estratégicas que promovam cadeias produtivas agropecuárias mais sustentáveis, inclusivas e livres de desmatamento e conversão. A posição requer uma combinação de competências técnicas e estratégicas, além de forte capacidade de articulação e engajamento com diversos setores.

Esta função possui como foco transversal o desenvolvimento de soluções e estratégias para reduzir o desmatamento associado às cadeias de valor, especialmente as de soja e carne, atuando para influenciar positivamente as dinâmicas de oferta e demanda entre países, empresas, fornecedores e formuladores de políticas públicas e privadas.

Principais atividades e/ou responsabilidades:

Engajamento e articulação institucional

  • Representar o WRI Brasil em articulações nacionais e internacionais, participando de eventos, coalizões, grupos de trabalho e forças-tarefa relacionados à sustentabilidade das cadeias de valor agropecuárias, com especial atenção às agendas associadas à eliminação do desmatamento e conversão de ecossistemas nas cadeias de soja e carne.
  • Estabelecer e manter parcerias estratégicas com organizações públicas, privadas, multilaterais, academia e sociedade civil, promovendo a colaboração para ações transformadoras que favoreçam cadeias mais responsáveis e transparentes.
  • Promover e fortalecer o uso de ferramentas e tecnologias relacionadas ao uso da terra e à rastreabilidade de cadeias produtivas, Global Forest Watch Pro e outras soluções de monitoramento e verificação aplicadas ao setor agropecuário.
  • Comunicar de forma estratégica os resultados, pesquisas e recomendações do WRI para públicos diversos, incluindo formuladores de políticas e o setor privado, com vistas a influenciar padrões de produção e consumo mais sustentáveis e livres de desmatamento.
  • Trabalhar com outros gerentes da área para gestão compartilhada na estratégia do programa, reportando metas e progressos, bem como liderar a elaboração de propostas e pesquisas com abordagem interdisciplinares.

Gestão do portfólio de projetos

  • Liderar o portfólio de projetos relacionados à promoção de cadeias de valor sustentáveis, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, no prazo e dentro do orçamento, com foco em iniciativas que promovam o monitoramento, a rastreabilidade e a adequação a protocolos setoriais.
  • Desenhar, planejar e implementar estudos e pesquisas que impulsionem a transição agropecuária brasileira para sistemas ambientalmente corretos, socialmente justos e economicamente viáveis, com atenção especial às relações de oferta e demanda em mercados nacionais e internacionais.
  • Identificar e propor políticas e instrumentos financeiros, regulatórios ou de mercado que promovam melhores práticas produtivas e comerciais, tanto para pequenos produtores quanto para cadeias de larga escala, especialmente nos setores de soja e carne.
  • Contribuir com a elaboração de relatórios técnicos e analíticos, artigos científicos e materiais para disseminação de conhecimento, com foco em soluções para eliminar o desmatamento e fomentar a rastreabilidade e a transparência nas cadeias agropecuárias.
  • Contribuir com o planejamento financeiro e gestão de demandas estratégicas e operacionais do programa, bem como, supervisionar relatórios narrativos e financeiros destinados a doadores, garantindo qualidade, precisão e aderência aos requisitos contratuais.
  • Garantir o alinhamento das iniciativas com as estratégias institucionais do WRI Brasil e do WRI Global, particularmente no que tange ao combate ao desmatamento nas cadeias produtivas.

Captação de recursos ( fundraising )

  • Identificar oportunidades de financiamento e colaborar com a equipe de Desenvolvimento do WRI Brasil na elaboração de propostas e na negociação com financiadores, com ênfase em projetos voltados à promoção de cadeias livres de desmatamento e à implementação de soluções inovadoras de monitoramento e rastreabilidade.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento do portfólio de projetos da área, alinhado às prioridades estratégicas e à missão do WRI, com foco especial na atuação sobre as cadeias de soja e carne.
  • Cultivar relacionamentos com doadores e parceiros estratégicos, assegurando a sustentabilidade financeira dos projetos de cadeias de valor e ampliando o impacto das ações institucionais.

Gestão de equipe

  • Liderar, supervisionar e inspirar a equipe responsável pelos projetos de cadeias de valor trabalhando em alinhamento com a equipe de RH, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e orientado à excelência, com foco no desenvolvimento de competências relacionadas ao monitoramento e rastreabilidade de cadeias produtivas.
  • Coordenar processos de planejamento, monitoramento e avaliação de desempenho, assegurando a entrega de resultados e o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe.
  • Gerir processos de mudança e inovação, fortalecendo o comprometimento e superando resistências, especialmente na implementação de soluções que promovam a transparência e a sustentabilidade nas cadeias de valor.
  • Estimular o aprendizado e o intercâmbio de conhecimentos dentro da equipe e com outras áreas do WRI, especialmente no que se refere às dinâmicas de mercado, aos setores produtivos prioritários e às relações comerciais internacionais.
  • Contribuir com iniciativas institucionais e de RH para promoção das políticas e iniciativas da organização junto a equipe

Requisitos e Qualificações necessários

Introduction to GPS (Gilead Patient Solutions)

In some parts of the world, progress feels inevitable. Access is often taken for granted and the next life-saving innovation is always on the horizon. In other parts of the world, access to essential health services is in doubt and treatable diseases affect thousands of lives every day.

Gilead is a bridge to a healthier world. Building on our legacy, we forge connections — between patients and their communities, across borders, between public health, providers and private industry — to create solutions that address critical health inequities in low- and middle-income countries.

Together, we deliver healthcare access and choice to the people and places that need it most.

We have had a pivotal role in the history of providing access to life-saving medicines in low- and middle-income countries with decades of experience in pioneering novel, collaborative approaches. More than 30 years on, we remain steadfast in our commitment to expanding access to healthcare for everyone, everywhere through sustainable solutions that will have an impact for generations to come.

We are committed to broad patient reach through pioneering access programs that touch all parts of the healthcare ecosystem.

We are the largest private funder of non-profit HIV programs in the world and in the U.S.

Gilead is committed to creating a healthier world for everyone.

Today, half the world’s population lacks access to essential basic health services. To change this, we must innovate – by developing new medicines AND by ensuring their impact wherever the unmet need is greatest.

That’s why for decades we have partnered with governments, communities and other stakeholders worldwide to expand access to medicines, help address the root causes of health inequities and end epidemics of HIV, hepatitis and other diseases in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).

title: Sales Development Representative - US Market
description:
A little about us

xChange is the world’s first online B2B marketplace to trade and lease shipping containers. We are a Series B startup with the ambition to become the world’s first and favorite place to buy containers, empowering local traders to seamlessly source and resell boxes while serving as the go-to sales channel for original equipment owners and wholesalers.

Our team of 50+ like-minded xChangees from a great variety of nationalities has made this possible! We have scaled far beyond the small start-up we once were and continue to disrupt the industry together.

The Role

Your next opportunity—what you'll be doing and how you'll make an impact.

As a Sales Development Representative, you will play a key role in driving high-volume B2B sales of shipping containers. This is a highly transactional sales role where you’ll be responsible for managing the entire sales cycle—from sourcing and qualifying leads to closing deals. You will actively identify customer demand, respond quickly to inquiries, and match clients with available container inventory.

Your day-to-day will involve high outbound activity, conducting calls and emails, negotiating pricing, and building strong relationships with our B2B clients. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, fluency in English is essential, and prior experience working with American clients or markets is highly preferred.

Location

Where you'll be based and how we collaborate globally.

Our headquarters is located in the heart of Hamburg, Germany, with team members distributed across the globe. This is a hybrid position based in São Paulo, Brazil , where you’ll regularly collaborate in person with local colleagues to share ideas and drive customer success while having the flexibility to work from home as well. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, U.S. time zone is required.


Your Impact

What you'll own, drive, and contribute to our success.

  • Identify and qualify new B2B sales opportunities for the US market by understanding customer container needs and matching them with available inventory

  • Act as the first point of contact through outbound calls, emails, and networking to generate, capture and convert demand

  • Build and manage a pipeline of prospects, closing container deals in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment

  • Collaborate closely with the marketing team to optimize lead quality, outreach strategies, and market targeting

  • Use Pipedrive to track leads, monitor sales performance, and gain insights to continuously improve conversion rates

What Makes You a Great Fit?

The experience, skills, and mindset that will help you thrive.

  • You bring hands-on experience in B2B sales backed by experience in cold calling and outbound prospecting —ideally within a fast-paced transactional sales environment

  • You are a self-starter, highly motivated and driven who confidently drives sales through persistence and a positive attitude

  • You excel at building and managing customer relationships, understanding client needs, and turning demand into closed deals

  • Your strong pipeline management skills, persuasive negotiation abilities, and clear communication style help you drive results

  • You think entrepreneurial, act proactively, and stay organized while handling multiple leads and fast-moving opportunities

  • You're a team player who thrives in a collaborative environment, stays adaptable in a dynamic market, and brings the drive and resilience needed to hit ambitious sales targets

What to Expect

Insights into perks, culture, and earning potential.


Earning potential: As a part of our sales team, you will have an attractive uncapped commission package motivating you to not only hit your targets but exceed them as a true hunter.

Ownership & impact at xChange: You will have a direct stake in xChange as a shareholder with a competitive virtual equity package! You will also have full ownership and trust to drive impactful topics, supported by smart and driven individuals. Plus, get personal coaching and counseling for both professional development and personal support through our partnership with Nilo.health.

xChange culture & collaboration: Our diverse and talented team operates with flat hierarchies and a growth-focused mindset which fosters an open-minded, collaborative, and high-performance driven culture where A-players thrive.

AI Focus: We believe AI is a game-changer for sales success. At xChange, you’ll get hands-on experience with AI tools designed to streamline sales operations, enhance your skills, and boost your conversion rates. This is a unique opportunity to grow alongside AI technologies that will empower you to work smarter and close more deals.

Other perks at xChange: 36 vacation days for remote employees outside of Germany, mental healthcare & coaching program, language courses and many more. Feel free to ask the Talent team for details

If this sounds like your future job, all we need is your CV which you can submit through the application link!

Job description

Seja bem-vindo à sua conexão com o futuro!

Somos uma empresa nascida no interior de Minas Gerais e crescemos cultivando dedicação e empreendedorismo no cerne do nosso DNA.

Nos expandimos para outras regiões e hoje estamos presentes em mais de 100 localidades do estado, onde nos consolidamos como referência em serviços de telecomunicações, e nos preocupamos em fornecer uma conexão de excelência para nossos clientes.

Se você é um profissional apaixonado pelo que faz e está em busca de construir um mundo de possibilidades, queremos nos conectar com você!


Main responsibilities

Estes serão seus desafios comoAnalista de Redes e Sistemas :

  • Assegurar o monitoramento eficiente da rede por meio da utilização dos softwares (Solarwinds, Zabbix, Nagios);
  • Analisar e executar a configuração lógica de equipamentos de larga escala por meio da especificação do fabricante e adaptação ao cenário da Valenet;
  • Analisar e executar projetos de redes, através da configuração e homologação dos equipamentos no ambiente de teste;
  • Realizar configurações de roteamento de clientes especiais para garantir que o projeto seja executado com assertividade de acordo com a demanda do cliente;
  • Confeccionar e executar projetos lógicos de readequação de rede;
  • Analisar e responder a incidentes de redes, registrando os incidentes e tratativas aplicadas através de chamados no CRM.

Requirements and skills

Se identificou com o nosso desafio? Você está a um passo! Conheça os requisitos e veeeem

  • Ensino Superior em Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia (Computação, Telecomunicações, Eletrônica, Controle e Automação), Sistema de Informação ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento básico em conceitos de VLAN: trunk, access, vlan nativa, STP;

Conhecimento básico de redes, conceitos de IP, Masc, gateway, DNS, DHCP, roteamento estático e dinâmico (com ênfase em OSPF);

  • Conhecimento básico em sistema operacional (linux e windows);
  • Noção do funcionamento do GPON e rede FTTH;
  • Interpretação de gráficos (matemática básica);
  • Conhecimento básico em enlaces de frequência aberta, rede wireless;
  • Troubleshooting de roteamento básico, ping, traceroute, nslookup.

Additional information

description:
A Jaguar Mining está comprometida em promover a diversidade e a inclusão em sua equipe, e, por isso, encoraja indivíduos de diferentes origens e identidades a se candidatarem a esta oportunidade.
Estamos empenhados em criar um ambiente de trabalho mais equitativo, onde valorizamos as características únicas de cada pessoa. Queremos evoluir junto com a sociedade, e esse é um passo fundamental para alcançarmos essa meta.
Estamos à procura de pessoas que se identifiquem com nossa cultura e que desejem contribuir para o nosso crescimento. Junte-se a nós nesta jornada em direção a um futuro mais inclusivo e diversificado.
Venha fazer parte do nosso time como : AUXILIAR DE TOPOGRAFIA
Principais Desafios:

  • Auxiliar o Topógrafo nos levantamentos a serem efetuados nas frentes de lavra ou desenvolvimento, transportando em campo os equipamentos utilizados pela equipe de trabalho;
  • Fixar e posicionar as balizas, conforme orientação do Topógrafo;
  • Colocar os bastões e prismas nos pontos procurados, objetivando a obtenção das medidas à distância pela Estação Total;
  • Executar medições de distâncias curtas, utilizando trenas de aço ou fibra;
  • Cravar piquetes com pontos de marcações e estacas testemunhas, bem como marcar as identificações nos pontos das estacas testemunhas, conforme determinações do superior;
  • Auxiliar na medição de áreas diversas, utilizando prisma em detalhamento de desníveis e pontos, visando detalhamento do terreno;
  • Auxiliar na marcação de leques de detonação e cavilhamento na mina;
  • Auxiliar na marcação de pontos de direcionamento na mina, identificando e pintando-os na lateral e teto, a fim de identificar desníveis e grau de aprofundamento da galeria;
  • Ajudar na identificação e marcação dos furos de sondagem, para orientação dos operadores das máquinas;
  • Executar check-list de equipamento, verificando condições de operação, estrutura mecânica e anotando avarias encontradas, preenchendo formulário, visando relatar não-conformidades com equipamento;
  • Executar outras atividades, conforme necessidade e/ou a critério de seu superior.
Requisitos Obrigatórios:
  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Experiência com trabalho que exija esforço físico
  • CNH - B
